### [225] [Navigating Runtime Dynamism in Semantic Query Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04248)
*Hengrui Zhang,Xupeng Miao*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SeqoFlow 是一个端到端的语义查询服务运行时框架，在"查询内计划自适应"与"查询间抢占式调度"之间建立闭环：先在等价变换约束下枚举所有保语义等价的候选物理计划，再把查询分解为以阻塞算子为根的批级子查询组（SEU），并用小模型（SLM）做轻量级投机剖析来实时估计各算子成本/选择率，从而在批次边界安全地切换计划、抢占与恢复查询，支撑 SRTF 等短剩余时间优先调度。实验显示其端到端延迟显著优于 LOTUS、Eddies、静态启发式计划与 FCFS/MLFQ/PreemptDB 等策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 语义查询把关系算子与多个 LLM 语义算子耦合在一起，带来两个耦合层面的运行时动态性：(1) 查询间层面——查询动态到达/完成、资源需求异构，持续改变调度优先级；(2) 查询内层面——细粒度批次的异构特征与内容相关的模型行为，使算子成本与选择率在执行中不断波动，静态优化计划不可靠。二者形成循环依赖：查询间调度需要"剩余 LLM 工作量"估计，而剩余工作量取决于运行时计划选择，其成本只有在执行中才可观测。已有工作要么只做逻辑/物理优化（LOTUS、Cascades 扩展、规则重写、LLM 逻辑重写），要么只做调度/抢占（LLM serving 的 FCFS、MLFQ、chunked prefill、preemption、migration），未能端到端闭合这一循环：优化器孤立地为每个查询选计划，调度器把请求或整查询当作调度单元而不考虑备选计划，导致计划变更后剩余工作量估计失效。

Method: 1) 查询内等价计划枚举（§4）：只做无损优化，定义算子交换的两条规则——规则1数据依赖（父算子消费的属性由子算子产生则禁止交换）、规则2语义完整性（算子按 row-wise / set-wise / join 三类划分，仅允许两个 row-wise 之间或 row-wise 与 join 之间交换，其他组合禁止）；Lemma 2 给出交换等价性证明，Proposition 1/2 给出计划空间上界 N!/(2^J·∏h_F(op)) 与 MECE 性质。算法上采用分治式两阶段：Operator Pushup（自底向上把 row-wise 算子提升到"最大化提升树"作为种子）＋ Operator Pushdown（自顶向下分层枚举：层内重排 + 跨源分区下推，Alg.2–4），用位置向量记忆化去重，并用常规谓词下推等剪枝规则剔除被支配候选。2) 运行时服务框架 SpecAQP（§5）：把逻辑计划按阻塞算子切分为 n 元子查询树；同一拓扑槽位下的等价子查询变体构成 subquery group；每个 group 交由 SEU（Subquery Execution Unit）管理，是批级可抢占单元。SEU 流程为：调度器选就绪 group → 用 SLM 对代表性计划（row-wise 算子最大下推拓扑）做投机剖析（全批位图 + 逐行选择率/连接结果记录） → 虚拟代价评估器（Alg.6）把算子掩码、摊销因子、缓存命中传播到所有候选拓扑并聚合成本 → 选出代价最低变体在目标 LLM 上执行一个批次 → 更新调度器状态。3) 调度：SEU 提供批次级剩余时间估计，原生支持 SRTF；代价由 prefill/decode token 加权和给出，用残差平滑因子 β、老化因子 α（抑制长查询饥饿）与在线校准 ξ 修正。4) 实现细节（§6）：物化嵌套循环连接（可恢复而不重取内输入）、缓存/广播/指纹三个 lineage 原语以支持中途改计划、6K 行 Python、Pandas 数据模型、Qwen3-4B 作 SLM、Qwen3-32B 作执行 LLM（vLLM，TP=8，8×A100）。

Result: 在 BioDEX 派生的可控测试床（9 个 TPC-H 查询模板改造为语义算子，参数化选择率方差 δ(σ_op) 与序列长度方差 δ(seq_len)，外加 Legal/Patent 语料）上：固定 SRTF 时，SeqoFlow 同 P50 延迟下吞吐比 Static-1 高至 1.9×、比 Static-2 高至 4.3×，且在所有负载上饱和点更高；并超过"事后最优固定计划"Static-Best*（在 Patent/Legal 上优势最大）。SRTF 使 P50 相对 FCFS/MLFQ/PreemptDB 降低 2.5–4×（近饱和区），低负载时持平；SeqoFlow+SRTF 在 P99 膨胀前比 LOTUS/Eddies+FCFS 多承载 1.9× 负载，P99 仅比 SeqoFlow+FCFS 高 1.4× 以内（老化机制限制饥饿尾延迟）；有限到达场景 P50 比 LOTUS+FCFS 低 3.6×/3.5×，P99 平台低 2×。单查询优化相对 LOTUS 加速最高 7×，并达到/超过人工启发式 Static-1/2。开销：投机剖析对多数查询 <10%（最难 Q8 为 41.6%），计划枚举编译开销可忽略（>1000 候选计划时仍划算）。动态适应性：在 10%–90% 批次成本/选择率翻转场景下，SeqoFlow 逐批重选计划，相对 Eddies 端到端加速 1.32–1.43×，而 Static-Best* 随翻转比例上升持续退化。代价模型精度：>80% 批次 SLM 估计误差在 10% 内，>95% 批次实际执行的是真实成本 top-2 计划；查询排序 Spearman ρ 最高 0.92、成对排序正确率最高 94.5%（引入老化后降至 ≥74.8% 以换取代价可控的等待）；跨 SLM/LLM 组合（自建 Qwen3-32B、DeepSeek-Flash、GPT-6 Luna API）均优于 Static-Best*。

Conclusion: 本文提出 SeqoFlow，主张 AI 原生数据系统必须联合设计查询优化与调度：通过保等价的计划枚举 + 依赖感知的算子交换规则、批次级结构化可抢占抽象（SEU/subquery group）与轻量投机代价估计，把"运行时观测—查询内计划自适应—剩余工作量估计—查询间调度"闭环起来。实验证明该闭环可显著降低端到端延迟并提升系统容量，且开销可控。局限与未来工作：等价计划空间最坏可达 O(N!)，需研究保留运行时自适应能力的剪枝；尚未处理并发数据修改与一致性；跨查询的共享算子/重复 LLM 调用复用（可作物化视图问题）留待后续；设计对 LLM serving 系统与算子实现正交，便于集成。

Abstract: LLM-powered semantic queries increasingly combine relational processing with multiple LLM-based operators over unstructured data. Efficiently serving such queries is challenging due to runtime dynamism at two coupled levels. Across queries, dynamic arrivals and heterogeneous resource demands continuously change scheduling priorities. Within a query, heterogeneous characteristics across fine-grained input batches cause operator costs and selectivities to vary throughout execution, making a statically optimized plan unreliable. These two forms of dynamism create a circular dependency: inter-query scheduling requires estimates of remaining LLM work, while the remaining work depends on runtime plan choices whose costs become observable only during execution. We present SeqoFlow, a runtime framework that jointly adapts query plans and schedules concurrent semantic queries. SeqoFlow enumerates equivalence-preserving plan alternatives under operator dependencies and decomposes queries into fine-grained units, enabling safe plan adaptation and query preemption at batch boundaries. To support both decisions without exhaustively profiling candidate plans on the target LLM, SeqoFlow uses lightweight speculative estimation to capture runtime costs. These estimates jointly guide plan adaptation and inter-query scheduling, closing the loop between query optimization and LLM inference. Experiments across diverse query structures, data distributions, and arrival rates show that SeqoFlow substantially reduces end-to-end latency compared to existing semantic query systems, adaptive query processing techniques, and conventional scheduling policies.

</details>


### [226] [Text-to-SQL Models Make Choices Without Saying So](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04318)
*Yichen Xu,Shipei Lin,Chenhao Ma*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SpecBridge 构造"请求集"(request set):同一数据库、同一查询,只改变一个计算选择(如计数单位、并列取行、聚合层级、缺失值处理、截断边界),生成三个请求——两个各自指定一种解读(A/B),一个留开放——并以执行结果而非字符串匹配来打分。核心发现:四个模型在单独指定时几乎总能算出两种解读(在漏报的集合中 72–94% 可算对),但对开放请求只有 15–58% 同时返回两种解读,且常常不作说明;差距在"报告"而非"计算"。BIRD 在此类题上把超过五分之二的"错误"答案判错,实为另一种解读。据此提出 Decide-then-answer 两阶段方法:先判定是否存在开放选择,再为每种解读单独调用作答;相较生产助手的单一回答,开放请求全覆盖率提升 29–63 个百分点,精度不降,且比追问澄清少用 35.0–40.8 个用户回合/百请求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析师用自然语言向 text-to-SQL 系统要数字,常常不读 SQL。查询报错是安全的(错误可见),真正的危险是查询能跑通、返回一个看似合理的数字,却按分析师未预期的解读计算——例如"每部影片日均租金"既可解释为"先算每部影片日均价再取平均"(A),也可解释为"平均价除以平均租期"(B);两者在 Spider 的 sakila_1 上每个 rating 结果都不同。类似"公开债务抑制增长"的研究曾因"先按国家内平均再跨国平均"与逐年等权之别,使高债务国家增长率从 -0.1% 变为 2.2%。模型在措辞留有选择余地时静默地做出这类"沉默的选择"(silent choice),既不报错也不提示。现有基准无法检测:Spider/BIRD 每题只对单一参考 SQL 打分,猜中作者约定的模型与如实报告选择的模型得分相同;而 AmbiQT、AMBROSIA 等歧义基准的歧义位于 schema 或措辞(指代哪一列、范围/依附/含糊),不涉及"数字如何计算"这一计算类选择,且只评 SQL、不评说明,并把"对已定选择发出警告"记为错误。此外,现有评分无法区分"算不出"与"算出但不说"——前者需要更强的模型,后者只需一个额外的报告步骤。

Method: SpecBridge 流水线分"构造"与"挖掘"两条通道汇合。(1) 构造通道:先由模型一次性审阅 schema/数据建立列含义、单位、表关系的目录,此后生成不再调用模型;按算术深度(算术表达式嵌套)与步骤深度(依赖阶段数)受控生成查询,并用类型规则与数据检查(空结果、常量/冗余量、非正分母、过小组)过滤,配合精确的前瞻剪枝保证每个产出查询达到目标深度;随后由代码生成"精确描述"(逐项写明源行、join、未匹配行、过滤、分组、公式、缺失值、排序、limit、并列、SQLite 约定),再由 Sonnet 写成自然语言请求,Opus 复核需求有无缺失/改动/新增,失败者修订一次,再失败即丢弃。(2) 挖掘通道:对每条 BIRD/Spider 问题,比较模型对原问题(附 evidence)与对参考 SQL 精确描述的作答,仅当后者正确时归因于措辞,并分类为输出列/换列换值/未述需求/数值精度/开放选择;开放选择写成对参考 SQL 的编辑,双模型(Opus、Sonnet)各自独立判定,分歧保留,形成"选择库"(open 与 settled 两类,涵盖聚合层级、计数单位、并列、缺失值、截断、否定、量化词、指代列等)。(3) 汇合:代码先报告数据上"有意义的"位置(缺失值、join 重复匹配、distinct、并列),Opus 从库中取一个选择并给出精确 SQL 编辑,代码检查编辑可应用、可执行、结果不同且仍可被精确描述;Opus 依据一份列明"共享需求 + 唯一差异选择"的计划撰写三个请求(A 请求、B 请求、开放请求),由 Opus 与 Sonnet 双重评审加代码检查,仅当两评审都接受各自具体请求且至少一人接受开放请求对应两种解读时保留。307 个请求集经两位作者盲审保留 232 个,再限于参考 SQL 实际出现两种解读的选择类型,最终使用 204 个(12 个数据库:Spider/BIRD/LiveSQLBench 各 4 个)。评测:以执行结果判"算得对错"(数值容差、并列截断行可互换、执行错误记 0 分),以裁判模型判"是否点明该选择/陈述是否与 SQL 一致";四模型为 Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6 Sol、GPT-6 Luna,Opus 仅作生成/评审/裁判不入评。方法侧:Phase 1 Decide-then-answer(先一次调用列出解读,若仅一个则直接作答;开放时每个解读单独调用作答,再执行比对、相同结果合并),可选 Decide-then-search;Phase 2 保留原请求仅追加一句选择从句,而非重写。基线:Plain、Three samples、DtP、Single answer(Snowflake 式"我们把问题理解为…")、Clarifying question。统计:任务重抽样 2000 次、Wilson 区间、配对 McNemar 精确检验。

Result: 发现1(沉默选择):204 个请求集上,四模型对具体请求的准确率为 80–98%,几乎从不误报已定选择(每模型最多 1/204),但对开放请求即使自身能算对两种解读,能同时返回两种的仅 Sonnet 58%、GPT-Sol 48%、Haiku 31%、GPT-Luna 15%;点明选择的比例 38–70%;在漏报的集合中 72–94% 该模型单独被问时能算出漏掉的解读——差距在报告而非计算。Haiku 与 GPT-Luna 最常见结局是"能算两种却只静默给一种";Sonnet/GPT-Sol 次之。要求解释说明并不改善结果(具体请求正确数变化≤9/204,配对区间含 0);纯 SQL 采样 5 次也几乎不可能同时覆盖两种(55 集上每模型最多 14 次),而 Sonnet 一次带解释的作答即可覆盖 34 次。按选择类型看,聚合层级较好(Sonnet 68%),计数单位差(43%),并列最差(22 集中无一模型覆盖超过 1 集)。点明选择后仍只给一种解读的比例 10–65%。静默选择在本请求集上 76–91% 取基准约定解读,但在 BIRD 自身的并列与计数题上偏好反转(替代解读 90 例 vs 参考 37 例),说明静默取哪种随请求而变、用户无法从答案看出。AMBROSIA 上同样成立:漏掉的解读有 49–66% 可在无歧义版上算出,即使无歧义版全对,歧义题全部解读覆盖仍仅 12–28%;vagueness 题上可算比例 48–56%。发现2(基准盲区):BIRD 开发集 156 题(约十分之一)在另一解读下答案改变;在两种解读均成立的 79 题上,同时接受两种解读把四模型准确率从 25% 提升到 57%;BIRD 在此类题上判错的答案中超过五分之二在另一解读下正确。发现3(方法有效):Decide-then-answer 相对 Single answer,在 AMBROSIA 覆盖率高 28.9±3.5 点、在请求集上高 63.1±3.2 点,精度不降(-0.3±3.7 / +4.4±2.0),具体请求正确率高 6.3 点;第一步在 86–90% 的具体请求上判定"无开放选择",故其精度优势明显高于 Plain/Three samples/DtP(AMBROSIA 上高 9.4–19.2 点,请求集上高 5.9–52.0 点,均显著);对 DtP 在请求集上覆盖高 42.8 点。Decide-then-search 与 DtP 同 AllFound 但精度高 14.3 点。每 100 请求比 Clarifying question 少 35.0±3.3 个用户回合(AMBROSIA)、少 40.8±2.4(请求集),且最终答对数分别多 9.1±2.2 与 3.4±0.9。Phase 2:"保留请求 + 追加一句选择说明"能正确计算 80.7% 的解读,与原始具体请求持平(p=0.57),而改写式(解释式重写、独立自足问题)分别少 8.5 点(p=0.0004)与 10.5 点(p<0.0001);重写很少丢掉选择本身(仅 12%),主要丢公式、输出列或 join;在 85 条真实 BIRD 题上同样成立(58.2% vs 47.6%)。稳健性检查:换用 GPT-Sol 写作请求无自身家族优势;去掉人工复审时"同时返回两种"降至 11–48%,差距依然成立;12 个数据库上生成器交付 1198/1200 查询且均达目标深度。

Conclusion: 模型其实已经"握有"另一种解读,缺的不是能力而是一个把选择呈现给用户的步骤:一次判定是否开放 + 每种解读各一次作答即可把生产助手漏掉的内容补上,且不牺牲精度、比追问澄清更省用户轮次;用户选定后应保留原请求、仅追加一句选择说明,避免重写丢失公式等需求。相应地,(i) 报告选择可作为训练/奖励目标:每个解读有可执行参考,只在两种解读都返回时才给开放题奖励、对具体题的额外备选扣分,从而奖励报告而非乱猜;(ii) 基准应允许模型陈述所采假设并给出被搁置的替代解读,分别给出具体请求准确率、开放请求报告率、已定选择的克制性三项指标;(iii) 现有 SQL 错误检测器与弃答/验证器无法捕捉沉默选择,因为其 SQL 对某一解读是正确的——修正方向应是让基准承认多种有效参考,而非仅判错。局限:生成器只覆盖部分分析型 SQL,选择库来自 SQLite 上的两个基准,可能遗漏其他选择类型;未覆盖"量词"与"指代列"(后者由 AMBROSIA 的 vagueness 题佐证同样存在差距);每个请求集只测一个开放选择;开放请求只按两种解读评分,故报告的差距是保守下界;约定计数为下界;"Single answer/Clarifying question"是依据文档重建而非运行真实产品,两轮实验使用能立刻辨认自身意图的模拟用户;其他 SQL 方言、更长会话与分析师对"被报告的选择"的实际反应留作未来工作。

Abstract: A text-to-SQL answer can run, return a plausible number and still compute something other than what the analyst meant. This can happen when the request leaves a calculation choice open, such as whether to count rows or distinct entities, and the model settles it without saying so. Standard benchmarks cannot detect this, because they score each question against a single reference interpretation. We introduce SpecBridge, which tests such a choice by varying it alone: it poses three otherwise identical requests, one leaving the choice open and one per interpretation, and scores each answer by running it. The databases are real, and the choices are ones that made models fail on existing benchmarks. On 204 hand-validated tests, four language models usually compute each interpretation when asked for it, yet for the open request return both in only 15-58% of the tests where they can, often without mentioning the choice. The gap lies in reporting, not in computing. Benchmarks even penalize the alternative: on BIRD questions where such a choice changes the answer, over two in five of the answers marked wrong are right under the other interpretation. Because the gap lies in reporting, a system can narrow it without a stronger model: it first decides whether a request leaves a choice open, then answers each interpretation in its own call. On our tests and on AMBROSIA, an existing benchmark of ambiguous questions, this approach raises the share of open requests that get every interpretation by 29-63 points over the single answer that production assistants give, without lowering precision on clear requests. It also needs fewer user turns than asking a clarifying question.

</details>


### [227] [Order-Dependent Complexity of Enumeration and Direct Access for Conjunctive Queries on Dynamic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04519)
*Antoine Amarilli,Nofar Carmeli,Clémence Dumoulin*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文研究动态数据库上合取查询（CQ）答案的"带排名枚举"（ranked enumeration）与"带排名直接访问"（ranked direct access）的精细复杂度，排名函数取自由变量上的字典序。作者提出并刻画了"层次一致序"（hierarchy-consistent order）这一新条件：当用户指定的变量顺序是层次一致序时，可构造基于 view-tree/grounded-tree 的数据结构，在数据复杂度下以线性预处理、对数更新时间、常数延迟完成带排名枚举，并以对数访问时间完成带排名直接访问；当顺序非层次一致时，假设 OMv 猜想，带排名的直接访问在动态条件下被证明条件性不可行（存在下界）。该文为一份初步结果（preliminary results），非层次一致序下的带排名枚举问题留待后续版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作沿两条相互独立的路线发展：(1) 动态数据上的枚举与直接访问——Berkholz 等人证明 q-hierarchical 自连接无关合取查询（SJFCQ）可在线性预处理、常数更新下常数延迟枚举，Keppeler 等人给出对应的直接访问结果（线性对数预处理、对数访问与更新），并证明非 q-hierarchical 查询在 OMv 猜想下条件性不可行；(2) 静态数据上的带排名（有序）枚举与直接访问——Tziavelis 等人给出任意字典序枚举（对数延迟），Carmeli 等人给出带排名直接访问（对数访问）。但这些工作都不同时处理"更新"与"用户指定顺序"这两个维度，且输出顺序通常由数据结构实现决定而非用户指定的字典序。作者的目标是把这两条路线接起来：确定在动态环境下究竟哪些用户顺序是可支持的。

Method: 1) 形式化：定义字典序（由自由变量上的全序诱导）、带排名枚举/直接访问在更新下的变体，以及预处理、延迟、访问、更新四个时间参数的组合复杂度度量（RAM 模型，字长 Θ(log n)）。2) 数据结构：沿用 Keppeler 等人的 q-tree、Kara 等人的 view-tree/grounded-tree；grounded-tree 中每张表按父视图自由变量分组为 bucket，每个 bucket 用按排名字函数排序的 B+-树实现（插入/删除 O(log|D|)，取后继 O(1)）。3) 层次一致性（Definition 4.1）：q-hierarchical 查询在自由变量上诱导偏序 x_i <_Q x_j 当且仅当 atoms_Q(x_j) ⊊ atoms_Q(x_i)；全序 ≺ 若为该偏序的线性扩张则称 hierarchy-consistent。4) 关键引理（Claim 4.4）：改进 q-tree 构造算法，用 ≺ 打破"atoms 集合相同"的变量之间的平局，可在 O(|Q|^{O(1)}) 时间内构造与 ≺ 兼容（≺ 是其拓扑序在自由变量上的限制）的 q-tree。5) 预处理（Proposition 3.5）：自底向上求值视图、对每个 bucket 线性排序并建 B+-树，总时间 O(|D|·|Q|)。6) 更新（Lemma 4.5）：插入/删除沿 view-tree 从叶子到根的路径向上传播，必要时检查各子 bucket 是否存在，单次更新 O(|Q| log|D|)。7) 带排名枚举（Theorem 4.6 / Algorithm 1）：按 ≺ 顺序对自由变量做嵌套循环，每次输出后找到最右侧"当前元组非其 bucket 末尾"的变量并前移、其后变量重置为各自 bucket 首元组；延迟 O(|Q|)。8) 带排名直接访问（Theorem 4.8）：在 grounded-tree 的自由变量子树中为每个元组维护权重 w(t)（以 t 为前缀的答案数，叶为 1，投影视图取和，连接视图取积），前缀和 start_b(t) 不显式存储而是通过遍历 B+-树按需计算；再改编 Carmeli 等人的"Lexicographic Direct-Access"算法，访问时间 O(|Q| log|D|)。9) 下界（Theorem 5.1 + Lemma 5.2）：非层次一致序下取投影 Q' = Π_{X_i}(Q)，证明 Q' 非 q-hierarchical（违反定义 2.1 条件 ii），并把 Q' 的枚举归约到 Q 的带排名直接访问——先用直接访问取第 k 个答案，再在秩区间上二分搜索"投影发生变化"的下一个秩 k'，延迟 O(t_a log N)；结合 Theorem 2.2 与 OMv 猜想得出条件性下界。

Result: 上界（层次一致序）：存在算法在 ⟨|D|·|Q|, |Q|, |Q| log|D|⟩ 时间内完成带排名枚举（预处理、延迟、更新），即数据复杂度下线性预处理、常数延迟、对数更新；存在算法在 ⟨|D|·|Q|, |Q| log|D|, |Q| log|D|⟩ 时间内完成带排名直接访问，即线性预处理、对数访问、对数更新。相比无排名情形，唯一代价是枚举的更新由常数降为对数。下界（非层次一致序，Theorem 5.1）：假设 OMv 猜想成立，则对任意 q-hierarchical SJFCQ 与任意非层次一致的自由变量顺序，不存在多项式预处理、O(|D|^{1-ε}) 更新时间、O(|D|^{1-ε'}) 访问时间的带排名直接访问动态算法；即层级一致性与带排名直接访问的高效性互为充要条件（条件性二分）。对带排名枚举则暂无匹配下界：作者推测非层次一致序下仍可高效支持，只需在延迟上再乘一个对数因子，计划把 Tziavelis 等人基于 Lawler-Murty 的 anyK-part 算法改造到 grounded-tree 上，并把权重的动态维护纳入数据结构（细节留待未来版本）。

Conclusion: 本文给出了动态数据上 CQ 带排名枚举与直接访问的一个初步（条件性）二分：用户指定的自由变量顺序是否为查询原子集合层次结构的线性扩张（层级一致性）是可支持性的判定标准。层级一致时，带排名枚举与直接访问几乎保留静态/无排名情形的全部优势（仅更新多一个对数因子）；非层级一致时，带排名直接访问在 OMv 猜想下不可高效实现。局限在于：(i) 仅覆盖 q-hierarchical 且自连接无关的 CQ；(ii) 下界依赖 OMv 猜想；(iii) 非层级一致序下带排名枚举的问题尚未解决，仅给出用 Lawler-Murty 与动态权重维护的改进思路；(iv) 结论建立在初步报告层面，完整的动态带排名枚举算法与更细的分析有待后续版本。

Abstract: This note studies the fine-grained complexity of ranked enumeration and ranked direct access of conjunctive query answers over a dynamic database. We focus on lexicographically sorted answers, defined by an ordering on the query's free variables. From the literature, when no particular order is required, we know that when the query is self-join-free and q-hierarchical, we can build a data structure for enumeration (resp. direct access) with linear (resp. linearithmic) preprocessing and constant (resp. logarithmic) update time in the size of the database. For enumeration (resp. direct access), this data structure yields an algorithm that enumerates all query answers (resp. that returns the $k$-th query answer) with constant delay (resp. logarithmic access time). Our goal is to extend these results to ranked enumeration and ranked direct access, with the ranking function defined by a lexicographic order. We define a property on the order over the variables of $Q$, which we call being hierarchy-consistent. Given a user-specified query and hierarchy-consistent order, we first propose, for ranked enumeration under updates, an algorithm with linear preprocessing and logarithmic update time that enumerates all the query answers according to the user-specified order with constant delay. Moreover, for ranked direct access under updates, we propose an algorithm with linear preprocessing and logarithmic update time that returns the $k$-th tuple according to the user-specified order with logarithmic access time. In contrast, given a user-specified query and non-hierarchy-consistent order, we show a lower bound for ranked direct access under updates.

</details>


### [228] [ZeroGR: Filtering-First Constrained Decoding for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04715)
*Xiangrui Yang,Jiawei Yang,Liang Zeng,Daqian Ding,Ziqian Liu,Bing Tian,Cheng Peng,Yunfeng Zhao,Fangyu Zhang,Jiaqiang Liu,Xiao Liang,Yiming Qiu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: ZeroGR 是一个面向生成式推荐（GR）在线服务的"先过滤后打分"（filtering-first）约束解码系统。它用按解码步切片的过滤索引（step-sliced filtering index）压缩 GPU 内存，用共享槽位执行（shared-slot execution）与混合投影（hybrid projection）把"少算 logits"真正转化为低延迟，并用布局引导的流式构建（layout-guided streaming construction）在模型更新窗口内完成索引重建且不干扰在线推理。相比代表性基线，过滤+打分+候选选择流水线延迟最高加速 9.9×，GPU 索引内存最多降低 74.5%，索引重建加速 278×，且与"先打分"相比推荐质量几乎不变（返回列表平均重叠 99.9%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）用语义标识符（SID）序列逐 token 自回归生成物品，beam search 的每一步都必须同时做"打分（scoring）"与"过滤（filtering）"。工业界目录规模下可能 SID 序列空间超过 10^16，而有效序列仅 10^7–10^8，绝大多数候选无效。现有系统普遍采用"先打分后过滤"：先对整码本做全投影算出 B_ℓ·|V_ℓ| 个 logits，再屏蔽无效 token。实测有效候选密度 ρ_ℓ 在第 2 步仅 14.29%，到第 5 步降到 0.05%，意味着 85.7%–99.95% 的投影算力、logit 物化与 mask 开销被浪费在无效延续上。作者追问：既然过滤先行可以省掉这些工作，它是否会损害推荐质量？原因是 GR 用 beam search 跨前缀做全局排序，两种顺序的 softmax 归一化分母不同（全集 vs 有效集），理论上会改变相对排名。作者在 MovieLens-1M 上验证两种顺序返回列表平均重叠 99.90%、各 cutoff 下 Recall@K 几乎一致（早期步概率质量集中在有效 token 上，后期步分数主要由早前步决定），从而证明"先过滤"在质量上可行。随后的系统挑战有三：GPU 内存预算下的索引表示；不规则（选择性）工作负载如何在 GPU 上高效执行（否则少算反而不更快）；以及目录与 SID 随模型刷新时如何重建索引而不抢占 GPU 算力与 H2D 带宽。

Method: ZeroGR 由三部分组成。

（1）步切片过滤索引：把约束表示为 L 个按步独立的映射 M_1…M_L，每个映射给出"前缀→有效下一 token 及其后继状态"。有效候选密集的步用稠密映射（后继表按 token 对齐，供全投影直接使用）；稀疏的步用稀疏映射（一个 SID 数组 A_ℓ 存全部有效 token，一个边界数组 R_ℓ 划分各前缀的段，条目位置本身即后继状态，故无需后继数组；末步 SID 即完成标记，无需额外字段，也不存物品 ID）。这带来两项内存节省。

（2）执行引擎：共享候选槽位——每步给每个 beam 分配等长的一行槽位（稀疏映射行长为该步最长段长度，稠密映射为 |V_ℓ|），槽位存 token、后继状态、分数，空槽分数为 −∞，各阶段直接原地读写，无需计数/前缀和即可定位。混合投影——提供稠密+全投影、稀疏+全投影、稀疏+选择性投影三种组合，在模型更新前用 warm-up 请求实测各步延迟并固定最优组合（解码循环零决策开销）。选择性投影用专门的过滤 kernel（一线程一槽位，仅填有效槽并构建只含有效槽的工作队列，队列任务上限 64 槽）与投影 kernel（固定数量线程块循环消费队列，每任务把该 beam 的 hidden 向量载入共享内存，warp 内做点积并用 warp 级归约求和，直接写回槽位）。选择阶段按候选数用两种 top-k kernel：候选多时用基数选择 kernel 多块多趟求第 B 大，单块可容纳时用小 top-k kernel 在块内共享内存排序并与 gather 融合。

（3）索引构建：布局引导流式构建——在 CPU 上两遍完成，第一遍利用排序后的 item SID 表与相邻序列的最长公共前缀（LCP）统计每步有效延续数 n_ℓ 并分配数组，第二遍并行填充；表被切分为 C 个连续块，两遍均可并行，用独占前缀和给每块分配不相交的输出区间；再用两个可复用 pinned buffer 双缓冲，CPU 生成一批的同时异步 H2D 传输上一批，使传输与生成重叠且避免一次性 H2D 突发流量。

Result: 实验平台为单张 NVIDIA RTX 4090 D（24GB）+ 两颗 Xeon Gold 5520+，部分实验在数据中心 GPU 上进行；对比基线为 Unconstrained（无约束）、CPU trie（自研线上系统，前缀树在主机内存）、FlashTrie（GPU 上 succinct bit-vector 前缀树）、STATIC（展平前缀树的稀疏 GPU 索引，先打分后过滤）。数据集包括工业生成式搜索 Search（约 10 亿条 5-token SID，输出头 18,432 token）、Watch（约 41.7 亿条 3-token SID，输出头 8,192 token）与合成 Synthetic-7（7-token，2^30 条序列）。结果：整体过滤+打分+选择流水线延迟最高加速 9.9×；Search 数据集上 batch=32 时 5 步解码耗时 FP32 9.68 ms、FP16 1.88 ms（FP16 下比 Unconstrained 快 9.1×），FP16 在数据中心 GPU 上 batch 1–32 稳定在 0.93–1.07 ms，而 Unconstrained 与 CPU trie 随 batch 增大明显变慢；Watch 上对 CPU trie 加速 32.4×–204.9×，比 Unconstrained 快 1.21×–1.43×（FP32），比 STATIC 快 2.0×–3.2×；Synthetic-7 上 beam 256、batch 32 时比 Unconstrained 快 10.7×，词表 V=16,384 时加速 19.5×，且 batch 32 延迟在 3.1–4.5 ms 间几乎不随词表宽度变化。逐步分解显示第 2 步最贵、第 3–5 步各约 0.08 ms（FP32/batch1），过滤+投影占 STATIC 延迟的 97%，该阶段相对 CPU trie 加速最高 120×。消融：naive 选择性投影只算 71,189 个 logits 却比全投影（2,359,296 个 logits）慢 5.1×（2,594.9 μs vs 507.8 μs），ZeroGR 的选择性投影同量 logits 仅 305.1 μs，比 naive 快 8.5×、比全投影快 1.66×；加入小 top-k kernel 与投影模式选择后，FP16 解码延迟相对纯选择性再降 27%（2.61→1.88 ms）。内存：ZeroGR 索引在 Search 上 8.51 GB（STATIC 20.78 GB、SID 表 27.52 GB），Watch 上 8.70 GB（STATIC 34.07 GB、SID 表 114.44 GB），分别比 STATIC 小 59.1% 与 74.5%，STATIC 在 Watch 上甚至无法装入 24GB 显存。构建：ZeroGR 在 0.914 s 内完成重建，仅为 STATIC 时间的 0.36%，比 Naive CPU（同索引串行构建）快 278×；60 s 更新窗口内仅需 0.144 GB/s 的 H2D 带宽，而 Naive CPU 需 ZeroGR 的 71.7×；双缓冲方案比 Full host 快 2.57×、比 Single buffer 快 1.30×。

Conclusion: 论文证明在生成式推荐的约束解码中，"先过滤后打分"在推荐质量上与"先打分"基本等价（列表重叠约 99.9%），但能省去 85.7%–99.95% 的无效投影算力，因此值得做成系统级优化。ZeroGR 的贡献在于：把目录约束从"输出约束"重新理解为"计算约束"（Insight 1），并把约束分解为按步独立的映射族（Insight 2），从而以步切片索引在有限显存内同时支持稠密/稀疏两种表示；用共享槽位 + 混合投影把不规则的选择性工作转化为规则、可并行的 GPU kernel；用两遍式并行 + 双缓冲流式构建在更新窗口内完成重建且不干扰在线服务。核心结论是：算得少并不等于跑得快，执行模型才是把 logit 计算量削减转化为端到端延迟下降的关键。局限与未来方向可从文中看到：投影模式/映射表示/top-k kernel 需在每次模型更新时通过 warm-up 重新选择；索引重建仍在 CPU 上进行，依赖 LCP 递增计数；实验聚焦受限解码阶段，未计入模型推理时间；Watch 这类约束稀疏度低（早期步几乎全有效）的场景下 ZeroGR 优势明显缩小，FP16 大 batch 时甚至略慢于 Unconstrained（因其不做查找且不保证输出有效）。

Abstract: Generative recommendation is gaining traction in production, retrieving items by generating their identifiers one token at a time. The generated sequences must identify relevant catalog items, so constrained decoding couples relevance scoring with validity filtering. Because most possible sequences are invalid, scoring before filtering wastes computation on candidates that will be discarded. Our evaluation shows that filtering first can avoid this work with negligible impact on recommendation quality. We present ZeroGR, a filtering-first constrained decoding system for generative recommendation. ZeroGR uses a step-sliced filtering index to reduce GPU memory use by tailoring data representations to each decoding step. Its execution engine adopts shared-slot execution to accelerate data exchange across stages and hybrid projection to adapt computation to workload patterns, thereby reducing execution overhead. During index refreshes, ZeroGR applies layout-guided streaming construction to speed up updates and limit serving interference. Extensive evaluation shows that ZeroGR accelerates the filtering and scoring pipeline by up to $9.9\times$ over representative baselines while reducing GPU index memory use and accelerating index reconstruction.

</details>


### [229] [Knowledge Graph Lakehouse: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Managing Enterprise Knowledge Graphs at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04899)
*Bashar Ahmad,Christoph G. Schuetz,Loris Bozzato*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识图谱湖仓"（KG Lakehouse）：一种云原生微服务架构，把数据湖仓范式迁移到情境化知识图谱（CKG）的规模化管理上。系统在文档到达时按可配置的情境维度（时间、空间、主题）对其建立上下文索引并存入数据湖，查询时按需构建应用特定的 CKG，而非维护单一巨型 KG；构建结果可缓存。已在 Kubernetes 上以 Java 实现概念验证（5 个独立可部署服务 + 3 个格式引擎：AIXM/IWXXM/FIXM），并在分布式集群上通过 5 组实验验证：构建与摄取成本随查询范围而非语料规模增长，正确性经独立三重存储 oracle 在各层次深度验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业知识图谱（KG）虽被广泛视为异构数据集成与知识发现的自然数据模型，但规模化部署必须应对大数据的三个 V（volume/velocity/variety）。情境化知识图谱（CKG）通过为事实附加情境信息缓解了部分挑战，但实践中大多数应用只关心与自身任务相关的情境子集：例如空管场景中，准备从慕尼黑飞往维也纳的飞行员只需要该航线上当日相关空域与天气，而管制员还需要所辖区及邻区的航班计划与航空器位置。维护覆盖整个欧洲空域网络的单一巨型 KG 既不现实也无必要，且更新代价高昂、时间敏感。因此需要一个能按查询语境动态裁剪知识子集、又能随数据流持续摄入的可扩展架构。现有 KGMS（如 Neo4j、Blazegraph、Spark GraphX、Amazon Neptune、Wikidata Query Service）均遵循"图先存在、查询再读取"的范式，材料化整图的成本是公认问题；联邦/虚拟 KG 避免持久副本但把查询委托给远端；图存储布局类工作（GraphAr、Stream2Graph）仍维护常驻图；Graph OLAP/Graph Cube 等把维度结构挂在快照与节点属性上而语境缺席。作者因此提出把湖仓范式（schema-on-read + 元数据/索引/缓存）迁移到 KG 管理上。

Method: 架构以 KG-OLAP 形式化模型为基础（基于描述逻辑，上下两层：上层含覆盖关系 ⪯、cell→module 映射 𝒞 与全局 TBox 𝒯_Σ；下层为各 cell 的局部断言模块 K_c），分五层：Ingestion（内容分析器按格式抽取原始数据项并做情境指派 κ: ℛ_𝒮→2^𝔇_Ω，文档原样存储，不做知识抽取）、Data Lake（对象存储保留原文 + 宽列存储中的情境索引 Idx ⊆ F×Doc）、Knowledge Graph（查询时按 cell 取文档、重用 φ 抽取原始项、语义提升 λ 生成断言，聚合为局部模块 K_c = ⋃_{x∈RD_c} λ(x)，并按需缓存 cell 粒度模块）、OLAP（slice/dice、roll-up、知识传播 K_c^⪯、知识图谱转换为 RDF quads / 标记属性图 / GraphFrame）、Frontend（统一入口，客户端注册 cube schema、提交文档与 KG 规格）。形式化贡献包括：slice/dice 的逐维可比较性判定、roll-up 的祖先与坐标粗化 ρ_l、以及两个构造期合并命题（Proposition 1/2），证明"合并模块 == 合并原始项一次提升"，从而保证缓存命中与新建结果不可区分、缓存只能省时不能改结果。实现为 Java + 容器镜像 + Kubernetes：5 个无状态服务（Gateway、Ingestion、Query、Graph、Inference），摄取走 Kafka 异步解耦、查询走 gRPC 同步流式；存储用 MinIO（原文）、Cassandra（索引三表 hierarchies/contexts/documents，按维度/cell 分区，cell id 为坐标哈希）、Redis（两级缓存：进程内 L1 + 共享 L2，带过期与精确失效）；格式引擎（analyzer+lifter）运行时插件化发现；推理可选，独立 Inference Service 用 Jena 做 RDFS/OWL 推理并输出独立派生模块；Web Console 提供可视化与运维视图。评测用确定性合成数据集族（种子固定的航空场景，单因子设计：地理范围、运营密度、时间跨度；AIXM/IWXXM/FIXM 三格式），正确性先于性能，且由独立 oracle（单独 Jena TDB2/Fuseki 三重存储，以对称差集为空判定）判定；性能在多节点 Kubernetes 分布式部署上测量全链路埋点数据。

Result: E1：摄取管道每文档约 27–28 ms 恒定成本，语料从 28 590 增至 324 456 文档（约 11 倍）时保持不变；异构格式无额外每文档开销；索引滞后随 worker 数近似线性下降（55 580 文档：1 607 s → 802 s → 390 s，加速比 4.12），吞吐受限于客户端给定负载而非系统上限；一份平均有效期约 6 天的 NOTAM 会展开为多日多条索引记录（156 份文档 → 约 941 条索引项）。E2：情境选择延迟随匹配上下文集扩大约 4 倍（14.7→58 ms，上下文数 1→767），而在固定范围下语料增大 11 倍延迟不增；索引体积 2.4–19.5 MB 对应 263 MB–1.81 GB 语料，约占 1%，且上下文结构（767 个）不随体量变化。E3：固定范围（188 上下文、56 474 quads）下构建时延在 11 倍语料增长中基本恒定（2 086/1 993/2 016 ms，最大最小比 1.05）；固定语料下随范围增长（单叶查询 63 ms/425 quads → 全区域 7.9 s/227 039 quads），边际成本约 10–11 ms/上下文、吞吐约 28 000 quads/s，存在约 63 ms 的每查询固定下限。E4：14 项性质检查（切片包含、roll-up 为被覆盖 cell 的并、roll-up 传递性、dice 交换性、下钻为 roll-up 逆、覆盖传递/知识传播）在 3 个层次深度上全部通过独立 oracle 判定。E5：对比预先材料化的基线（RML 映射 + SPARQL 生成完整立方 + Jena TDB2 批量加载）：材料化需先构建 726 万 quads 的整立方，峰值内存 46 GB、约 55 分钟（且内存随体量 33→46 GB 增长，最终无法在单机构建）；按需构建仅构建被查上下文，每上下文数十毫秒、内存约 1.4 GB，无整图上限；材料化立方含 40 511 个上下文而区域级查询仅读约 4%、机场级仅 1 个；新数据可见性上索引使 255 份新文档约 18 s 即可查询，而整立方重建需约 55 分钟。作者明确指出：按需构建不是"更高效地构建整图"，对于需要全图任意交叉查询或通用 SPARQL 端点的应用，材料化三元存储仍是更合适的方案，本架构的优势与该场景正交。

Conclusion: KG Lakehouse 面向"查询范围事先可声明"的工作负载（时间窗、区域、主题），反转了 KG 管理的常规顺序：原样存储持续到达的原始文档、索引其内容有效的情境、仅在查询点名时构建恰好所需的 CKG，永不构建整图。架构的 KG-OLAP 形式化基础带来实际推论：模块仅由被索引原始数据决定，故构造是确定性的、合并与构造可交换，缓存成为立方映射的部分物化，能省时但不能改变结果。实现将领域知识隔离在配置（cube schema、维度、层次、成员链）与格式引擎（内容分析器 + 语义提升器）之外，航空特性仅体现在配置声明与三个引擎上，迁移到新领域或新格式只需新增配置与引擎。评测支持核心命题：构建成本取决于查询范围而非语料规模，且正确性由独立 oracle 在各层次深度独立验证。局限与未来工作：数据湖仅追加，修正以新文档形式到达导致新旧断言共存（适合时效版本化的航空数据，但文档及其提升知识的撤回尚未解决）；情境操作在合并、知识传播与推理交互上的形式化有待完善；后续方向包括将交付的多种表示接入分布式 KG 处理栈（如 SANSA、Trinity）。

Abstract: Modern data architectures for integrating heterogeneous data sources to discover actionable knowledge include the data warehouse, the data lake, and the data lakehouse, which combines the flexibility of the data lake with the structured data management capabilities of the data warehouse through metadata, indexes, and caching. Enterprise knowledge graphs (KGs) offer an alternative approach to such integration for the purposes of data analysis, but handling them at scale must address the Three Vs of big data: volume, velocity, and variety. Contextualized KGs (CKGs) meet part of that challenge by enriching facts with contextual information, yet many applications require only a context-specific subset of that knowledge. We propose the Knowledge Graph Lakehouse (KG Lakehouse), a cloud-native microservice architecture that adapts the data lakehouse paradigm for management of CKGs at scale. The KG Lakehouse indexes incoming source documents along configurable context dimensions and stores these documents in a data lake, from which application-specific CKGs are constructed on demand instead of maintaining a single, monolithic KG. We realize the proposed architecture as a proof of concept, with independently deployable services built from established cloud technology; context dimensions and format-specific document handling enter as configuration, leaving the architecture independent of the application domain. We evaluate the implemented system in experiments on a distributed cluster deployment.

</details>


### [230] [Correctness Firewalls for Synthesized Database Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05173)
*Mohammad Javad Amiri,Carsten Binnig,Andreas Kipf,Tim Kraska,Ryan Marcus,Johannes Wehrstein,Chenyuan Wu,Geoffrey X. Yu,Zijie Zhao*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出"正确性防火墙"（correctness firewalls）这一中间路线：在该模式下，LLM 编码智能体可自由合成高性能组件（如基数估计器、有序数据搜索结构、压缩器），这些组件只能影响系统性能，绝不能影响查询结果。三个案例研究分别对应三种防火墙类型：advisory（仅建议）、guarded（受守卫约束）、certified（带形式化证明）。实验显示合成组件搜索有序数据比人工设计的已学习索引快至多 3 倍，压缩文本比 Zstd 小 1.5 倍。论文最后给出数据管理系统在不放弃正确性保证的前提下利用编码智能体的研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前高性能定制代码首次变得廉价：编码智能体可生成针对具体实例优化的数据系统，且随 LLM 进步会持续变强。但纯智能体化路径即使辅以强测试，也无法自动继承数据库社区数十年积累的正确性保证（确定性语义、ACID、一致性、可证明行为）。手写系统正确但性能受限、迭代慢；完全交给智能体则存在不可验证的行为漂移风险。核心动机是在"手工编写"与"智能体合成"之间找到可保证结果正确、同时允许性能激进优化的中间层。

Method: 核心抽象是"正确性防火墙"：一组轻量级设计模式/契约，使被合成组件的输出被限制在"性能可影响、结果不可影响"的边界内。防火墙通过接口层拦截合成组件的输出，并附加独立的正确性检查或证明，从而在架构上把智能体从"决策者"降级为"性能建议者/提供者"。论文给出三个案例：(1) 基数估计（cardinality estimation）——advisory 型防火墙：合成估计器仅作为优化器提示，查询计划仍由传统优化器最终校验/替换为精确统计，保证结果不变；(2) 在有序数据上搜索（searching sorted data）——guarded 型防火墙：合成的学习索引/搜索结构需通过守卫条件（如结果集与参照实现的等价性校验、边界与并发安全的检查）后方可被采纳，否则回退到传统结构；(3) 数据压缩（data compression）——certified 型防火墙：对合成压缩算法给出可验证的形式化规范/证明或往返（round-trip）正确性证书，确保解压后字节流与原数据完全一致，在此前提下自由追求压缩率与速度。作者同时比较了"依赖智能体测试/验证"（trusting agent-generated tests）与"独立于智能体的外部守卫"的差异，强调防火墙的正确性保证必须来自系统侧而非智能体自身。最后讨论从"保护合成代码"到"度量正确性代价"的研究议程。

Result: 早期实验表明：合成组件在有序数据搜索上比人工设计的已学习索引（如递归模型索引/UpLearner 类方案）快至多 3 倍；合成的文本压缩器可压缩出比 Zstd 小 1.5 倍的结果（在保持可解压正确的前提下）。这些结果表明在正确性防火墙保护下，智能体合成的组件能够超越长期以来精心手工调优的基线性能，说明"性能优化空间"远未被人类手工设计充分挖掘。论文为三个案例归纳出可复用的防火墙构造模式（advisory / guarded / certified），并给出按"保证强度"分级的正确性成本度量思路。

Conclusion: 正确性防火墙是在手工系统与智能体系统之间的可行中间地带：把系统正确性与合成组件的性能解耦，使智能体承担激进性能优化，而由系统的确定性构件承担正确性验证责任。三个案例证明该路线可同时获得显著性能收益（搜索 3 倍加速、压缩优于 Zstd 1.5 倍）与不变的结果语义。结论强调：数据管理系统可以在不放弃数十年积累的正确性保证的前提下规模化利用编码智能体。后续研究议程包括：如何保护/隔离被合成代码（沙箱、接口最小化、防注入式作弊）、如何度量正确性的成本（验证开销、守卫代价、性能-正确性权衡）、如何推广更多可验证子领域、以及如何评估智能体合成组件带来的净收益。

Abstract: For the first time in history, high-performance code is cheap. Today's coding agents can generate bespoke, instance-optimized data systems with excellent performance, and such agents will continue to improve as LLMs advance. But a purely agentic approach, even when validated with strong testing techniques, does not automatically inherit the correctness guarantees our community has spent decades building. We propose a middle ground between hand-crafted and agent-crafted systems: correctness firewalls, lightweight design patterns under which a synthesized component can affect a system's performance but never its results. Behind a correctness firewall, agents are free to synthesize fast components while the overall system remains correct. We present three case studies, each demonstrating a different type of firewall: cardinality estimation (advisory), searching sorted data (guarded), and data compression (certified). In early experiments, synthesized components search sorted data up to 3x faster than human-designed learned indexes and can compress text 1.5x smaller than Zstd. Drawing on these case studies, we outline a research agenda for how data management systems can exploit coding agents without giving up their hard-won correctness guarantees, from protecting synthesized code to measuring the cost of correctness.

</details>

### [231] [The Power of Bidegeneracy for Hypergraph Data Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04900)
*Marco Bressan,Stefano Clemente,Giacomo Fumagalli,Daniel Paul-Pena,C. Seshadhri*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 论文提出并系统研究了超图的“双退化度”（bidegeneracy）这一新的稀疏性度量：它是超图关联矩阵中“无重复行列子矩阵必含低权重行/列”的推广形式，严格蕴含（推广）有界度、有界秩、∞-退化度、超边退化度、(k,q)-核、nice 性等既有度量，并且是对偶不变的。作者证明：若超图的双退化度有界，则一族基本超图原语（邻接、相交、包含、并集、超集、子超图、Venn 图、顶点/边邻域计数与采样、偏匹配 partial match 等）都能做到近线性预处理 + (多)对数时间查询（含加权计数、采样、常数延迟列举）；并证明其核心是先把超图压缩成“区间表示”，再归约为 ℝ^d 中的正交范围搜索与盒刺穿问题。同时给出基于 Orthogonal Vectors Conjecture、强 SetDisjointness 猜想与布尔矩阵乘法猜想的条件性下界，表明对 κ 的指数依赖与“近二次预处理 / 近线性查询”基本不可改进；实验显示真实超图数据集的双退化度极低，框架具实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图（集合系统）在网络科学与数据挖掘中日益流行（合著网络、共现关系等本质上都是超图），但超图上的基本原语——是否存在同时包含两点的超边、两边是否相交、集合包含判定、给定边的相交边数、给定顶点集的邻域大小/并集大小/超集计数、诱导子超图、三边的 Venn（超三角形）模式、以及数据库中的偏匹配（wildcard 搜索）——在图上是平凡的（查邻接表即可），在任意超图上却极难，数据结构“黄金标准”是近线性预处理 + (poly)log 查询时间，而对任意超图这几乎不可能。因此需要一个既包含图与有界秩超图、又具实践动机的稀疏性条件。现有度量各有缺陷：图退化度类（含超图 l-退化度、超边退化度、(k,q)-核、nice 性、关联图的双退化度）虽在子图计数中有用，但既不给出输入的渐近压缩，也未用于通用数据结构；nowhere dense 一类过于苛刻（连所有图都排除），树宽/扩张性亦然。目标应是：刻画超图稀疏性、超图压缩能力与基本原语复杂度三者之间的内在联系。

Method: 技术核心分四层：(1) 定义双退化度 (κ_v, κ_e)：超图 H 是 (κ_v,κ_e)-双退化的，若每个无孪生（twin-free）子超图都含度数 ≤ κ_v 的顶点或大小 ≤ κ_e 的边；等价地，关联矩阵 M_H 的任意行列均不重复的子矩阵含 Hamming 权重 ≤ κ_v 的行或 ≤ κ_e 的列。它对偶不变，故一个原语的界可自动传给其对偶。(2) 构造区间表示：模拟图退化度的剥离过程，每次要么删除低度顶点/小边，要么合并孪生顶点/孪生边；用两棵辅助二叉森林 T_V、T_E 记录所有合并，后序遍历森林得到顶点序 V、边序 E 及每个顶点/边对应的少量区间 I(v)≤κ_v 个、J(e)≤κ_e 个，满足 soundness（关联恰由一侧区间认证）与 niceness（同一区间内的边/点有相同的对侧区间）。用带 η-散列的集合族数据结构可在 O(‖H‖ log^1.5‖H‖) 确定性时间内完成；矩阵视角下 M = M_V + M_E，行/列各含至多 κ 个连续 1 块，故输入可压缩到 O((m+n)κ) 空间——这是所有既有退化度所不具备的。niceness 性质是后续算法的关键“免费”副产品。(3) 查询归约：a) EdgePartialMatch/EdgeSat——把每条边嵌入 ℝ^{2κ_e+2}（坐标为 J(e) 各区间的端点），把查询化为一族轴对齐盒，做加权正交范围搜索（自建支持计数/采样/列举的 range tree），代价对 κ_e 指数；b) 固定查询长度 t 时对偶化为盒刺穿：每条边生成 O(κ_e^{t-1}) 个 (t+2) 维盒，查询向量为 (start(I), end(I), 查询顶点)，维度与 κ 无关，故 κ 依赖降为多项式，且借助 niceness 每个 I 只需检查一条代表边即可判“易”边；c) VertexNeigh（第二阶查询）——把邻域分为 N_0（两侧区间交叠，可归约为正交范围搜索）与 N_1（需借助 J 侧，可表示为 ℝ^2 上 O(κ_e‖H‖) 个矩形），N_1 归约为新提出的“并集刺穿”（union stabbing），用 Bentley 的带权并集线段树加路径复制（持久化）实现 O(1) 计数、O(log) 采样、O(log) 延迟列举。(4) 下界：把 Orthogonal Vectors 实例编码为超图（超集判定、边相交数、并集大小、邻域计数），把 SetDisjointness 编码为二部图/超图（邻域交集、邻接、Venn），把布尔矩阵乘法编码为集合包含查询，从而给出条件性下界。

Result: 主要定理与结论：(1) 区间表示定理——任意 (κ_v,κ_e)-双退化超图存在同参数的区间表示，且可在 O(‖H‖ log^1.5‖H‖) 时间内确定性计算；由此双退化度本身可高效判定（给定 κ_v 求最小 κ_e），但判定最优 (0,k)-区间表示等价于 k-consecutive-ones 性质，k≥2 时 NP 完全。(2) Theorem 1.2（固定查询长度 t）：预处理 O(‖H‖ κ^{t-1} log^{t+2}‖H‖)，计数/采样/常数延迟列举查询时间 O(κ log^{t+2}‖H‖)；当 κ=‖H‖^{o(1)} 时即近线性预处理 + 亚多项式查询。特例：Adj/Int/Union/Diff 计数查询 O(κ log‖H‖)；Superset/SubH 在 |S|=t 已知时 O(κ log^{t-1}‖H‖)；Venn(e,f,g) 预处理 O((κ_v log‖H‖)^2)、查询 O(κ_e log^2‖H‖)。(3) Theorem 1.3（任意长度公式）：预处理 ‖H‖ log^{O(κ)}‖H‖，查询 κ^{O(|φ|)} log^{O(κ)}‖H‖。(4) Theorem 1.4（VertexNeigh/EdgeNeigh）：预处理 ‖H‖ log^{O(κ)}‖H‖，查询 (κ log‖H‖)^{O(κ)}（在 κ_v 上指数、在 κ_e 上仅多项式），支持计数/采样/O(log)-延迟列举。(5) Theorem 1.5（下界）：若存在 2^{o(κ)}‖H‖^{2-δ} 预处理且 2^{o(κ+t)}‖H‖^{1-ε} 查询的算法，则 OVC 被推翻；即使 OVC 为假也仅是 n^α 的多项式改进，故对 κ 的指数依赖基本必要；Neigh 的界不可推广到邻域交集（NeighINT），即使 κ 为常数亦然（由 SDC 归约，查询需 ‖H‖^{1/2-ε}）；Adj/Venn 在一般超图上受 SDC 限制（近线性空间 + ‖H‖^{1/2-ε} 查询不可能）；Contain 由 BMM 归约得 α ≥ ω_0/2 或 δ ≥ (ω_0−2)/2。(6) 实际意义：6 个真实超图数据集的双退化度极低（κ_v 或 κ_e 与另一者为 0 时不超过 1477，且 κ_v 常 <20），因此指数项在实践中可控；框架可用于加速 partial match、Gaifman 图（projection graph）的近线性计算、超图let 计数、三边超三角形计数与超图随机游走。

Conclusion: 双退化度是把超图稀疏性、输入压缩与基本原语复杂度联结起来的合适抽象：它比所有既有超图退化度量更一般（是它们的严格推广）、对偶不变，并且首次为超图给出了“近线性预处理 + (多)对数查询”的一整套统一框架（含计数、采样、列举与加权版本），从而把数据库偏匹配、邻域统计、Gaifman 图计算、超图 motif/let 计数等任务纳入同一工具箱。其上界与 OVC/SDC/BMM 假设下的下界基本匹配，说明“对 κ 的指数依赖”与“近二次预处理或近线性查询”难以突破，上界已接近最优（即使猜想被推翻也只能获得小幅多项式改进）。局限与后续方向：通用情形的指数依赖与预处理中的 log^{O(κ)} 因子仍偏大；κ_v/κ_e 双参数的精细权衡需要更精细的下界；下界目前只覆盖部分原语（如 Contain 仅有 BMM 型下界）；并期待实际的库级实现与在真实超图上的端到端实验验证。

Abstract: A hypergraph $H = (V,E)$ describes a set system over a vertex universe $V$. Hypergraphs are increasingly popular in network science, as they represent interactions between subsets of vertices. A natural challenge is to design a data structure for $H$ to quickly answer basic questions about it, e.g. how many neighbors a vertex $v$ has or whether a hyperedge contains a vertex subset $S$. Such questions are trivial for graphs, for which we simply inspect the adjacency list. The gold standard, from a data structures perspective, would be near-linear time preprocessing and query answering in (poly)logarithmic time. Since this is unlikely for arbitrary $H$, we ask for well-motivated hypergraph properties that can make such a goal possible. We introduce bidegeneracy, a measure of hypergraph sparsity that strictly generalizes many other measures, including bounded degree, bounded rank, and bounded $\infty$-degeneracy. We show that bounded bidegeneracy yields fast hypergraph data structures. For a large set of fundamental queries, including their listing and sampling versions, we obtain near-linear preprocessing and (poly)logarithmic query time. Moreover, direct reductions from assumptions like the Orthogonal Vectors Conjecture suggest that, without assumptions on the input, these structures require almost-quadratic preprocessing or almost-linear query time. We use bidegeneracy to compute a compressed representation of $H$ and perform careful reductions to stabbing and searching problems in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our framework significantly extends the well-studied "partial matching" problem of finding database entries through wildcard search. It also uncovers an intriguing connection between hypergraph sparsity, compression, and the complexity of hypergraph primitives. We also find remarkably low bidegeneracy in hypergraph datasets from the literature, suggesting practical consequences.

</details>


### [232] [Gaussian Partitioning for Reliable Learning of Multi-Index Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05264)
*Ilias Diakonikolas,Giannis Iakovidis,Daniel M. Kane,Mingchen Ma*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We introduce Gaussian partitioning, an algorithmic primitive for distributions smooth with respect to a Gaussian. It partitions space into polyhedral regions so that almost all mass lies in thin strips restricting a few orthogonal directions. Within each strip, the conditional distribution approximately matches low-degree Gaussian moments in the unrestricted directions. Our construction builds on logconcave partitioning of Diakonikolas, Kane, and Ma (FOCS 2026). Under input marginals smooth with respect to the standard Gaussian, we obtain agnostic learners with error $(1+c)\mathrm{opt}+\epsilon$ for broad classes of Boolean multi-index models, including functions of halfspaces, low-dimensional convex concepts, and low-dimensional polynomial threshold functions. For functions of $k$ halfspaces, both agnostic and testable agnostic learners achieve this error with dimension dependence $d^{\mathrm{poly}(k/c)}$, improving the previous exponential dependence on $k/c$ in the agnostic exponent. For learning from positive examples with imperfect unlabeled data (PUI), we give algorithms and Statistical Query (SQ) lower bounds that qualitatively characterize complexity through Gaussian moment matching. For fixed smoothness and positive-mass parameters, we learn intersections of $k$ halfspaces with dimension dependence $d^{O(\log(k/\epsilon))}$ and matching SQ lower bounds, improving the previous $d^{\mathrm{poly}(1/\epsilon)}$ upper bound even for one halfspace. A general reduction from agnostic reliable learning to PUI yields negative reliable learners for these intersections with the same dimension dependence, for fixed smoothness. Finally, for PQ learning and testable learning with distribution shift, we prove qualitatively optimal SQ lower bounds of $d^{\Omega(1/\epsilon^2)}$, even for intersections of two halfspaces with Gaussian training data and arbitrary test distributions.

### [233] [A King for Almost Everyone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03838)
*Ziad Ismaili Alaoui,Oded Lachish,Nikhil S. Mande*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: A tournament is an orientation of a complete graph. A vertex $v$ controls a vertex $u\neq v$ if there is a directed path of length at most two from $v$ to $u$, and a $\delta$-king is one that controls at least $\delta(n-1)$ vertices. In the query complexity model, each query reveals the orientation of an edge. Shen, Sheng and Wu [SICOMP'03] established an $\Omega(n^{4/3})$ lower bound on the deterministic query complexity of finding a $1$-king, and a non-matching upper bound of $O(n^{3/2})$. Neither bound has been improved in over two decades, despite substantial progress on variants of the problem. For $\delta$-kings with $\delta < 1$, Biswas, Jayapaul, Raman and Satti [Discrete Applied Mathematics'22] showed that $O(n^{4/3})$ queries suffice to find a $\frac12$-king. Lachish, Reidl and Trehan [FSTTCS'22] improved this guarantee to $\frac12+\frac{2}{17}$ using $\widetilde{O}(n^{4/3})$ queries, and asked whether a larger fraction could be achieved within the same query bound. We answer this question affirmatively for every fixed fraction below one: for every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, we give a deterministic algorithm that finds a $(1-\varepsilon)$-king using $O(n^{4/3})$ queries. The design of our algorithm is informed by a structural analysis combining a sparse regularity lemma due to Allen, Kohayakawa, Mota and Parente [Electronic Journal of Combinatorics'14] with a new sampling argument based on a reachability theorem of Afek, Gafni and Linial [arXiv'19].

### [234] [A Family of Well-Behaved Multiflow Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03858)
*Joseph Poremba,F. Bruce Shepherd*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We introduce a family of cut-sufficient instances for undirected multiflow that generalizes single-source planar and fully-planar instances. We also show the family has an additive $6 d_{\max}$ error for converting a fractional flow into an unsplittable one.

### [235] [The Hyperclique Hypothesis is False](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03880)
*Nick Fischer*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The Hyperclique Hypothesis postulates that, for all constants $k > h \geq 3$, detecting a $k$-clique in an $h$-uniform hypergraph with $n$ vertices requires time $n^{k-o(1)}$. This hypothesis is false: there is an algebraic algorithm that detects (and even counts) $k$-cliques in $h$-uniform hypergraphs in time $O(n^{(1-\epsilon_h)k})$. Via known reductions, this also refutes the recently proposed $k$-AP Hypothesis. As a consequence, many problems with conditional lower bounds based on these two hypotheses may admit faster algorithms after all. This result is almost entirely due to AI.

### [236] [On the optimality of truncation among binary linear sketches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03979)
*Robinson D.H. Cung,Adway Girish,Emre Telatar*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study statistical inference and function evaluation problems in which the input binary vector is available only through a binary linear sketch, i.e., a fixed number of parity measurements. We show that under a certain monotonicity condition, simply truncating the input by retaining a subset of its coordinates is optimal among all linear sketches of the same size. In particular, this applies to distributed testing of correlations of binary vectors when they are of opposite signs and evaluating unate Boolean functions on uniformly random inputs. Additionally, given that truncation is optimal, we immediately have lower bounds for arbitrary binary linear sketches. To illustrate this application, we consider the one-way communication complexity of a distributional graph connectivity problem on $n$ vertices and show that truncation, and hence all binary linear sketches, requires $\Theta(n \log n)$ bits to achieve constant error, while a nonlinear protocol only requires $O(\log n)$ bits.

### [237] [A Constant-Factor Approximation for Capacitated Facility Location with Outliers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04094)
*Rajni Dabas*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give a deterministic polynomial-time $(60/11+\eps)$-approximation for metric capacitated facility location with outliers, with arbitrary opening costs and nonuniform hard capacities. The algorithm respects both capacities and the outlier budget. Its guarantee, approximately $5.455$, is close to the best known factor $5+\eps$ for capacitated facility location without outliers. The main ingredient is a local-search comparison for a common rejection penalty that retains the signed difference between the algorithm's and the comparator's rejection counts. Ordinary approximation guarantees for the penalty objective do not provide this comparison. We extend the exchange-forest accounting of Bansal, Garg, and Gupta \cite{BGG18} so that a nonnegative assignment remainder pays for rejection and cancels in the final bound. We then merge two penalty assignments whose served counts bracket the outlier quota. Grouping alternating paths by their terminal facility preserves capacities and shares opening costs. These ingredients give a $(20/3+\eps)$-approximation; starting each penalty run from the preceding solution improves the guarantee to $60/11+\eps$.

### [238] [Incremental Open Addressing Has No Time-Space Tradeoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04186)
*Martín Farach-Colton,Andrew Krapivin,William Kuszmaul*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper, we show that there is no time-space tradeoff in incremental open addressing: there is an incremental open-addressed hash table that supports $O(1)$ worst-case expected time insertions, positive queries, and negative queries, at any load factor (even load factor $1$). As an intermediate result, we also revisit the problem of constructing an incremental open-addressed hash table that does not perform reordering (does not move elements around over time). In this setting, we show that it is possible to get $O(1)$ amortized expected positive query time together with $O(1)$ worst-case expected insertion time, a combination that was not previously known to be possible.

### [239] [Online Metric Matching with Unknown i.i.d. Arrivals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04275)
*Tsubasa Harada*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study online metric matching with $n$ servers and $n$ requests drawn independently from an unknown distribution. Each request must be matched immediately and irrevocably to an unused server, and the algorithm receives no samples before the process starts. We give a randomized algorithm that is $O((\log\log\log n)^2)$-competitive on arbitrary metric spaces and $O(1)$-competitive on tree metrics. These guarantees match the corresponding bounds for known i.i.d. request distributions in [GGPW19] up to constant factors. More generally, our competitive ratio is $O(\alpha(n))$ whenever the Fair-Bias algorithm introduced in that work has competitive ratio $\alpha(n)$ for known i.i.d. arrivals on the same class of metrics. Consequently, proving that Fair-Bias is constant-competitive on general metrics would also yield a constant-competitive algorithm for unknown i.i.d. arrivals.

### [240] [Testing Implies Distance Estimation with Polynomial Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04276)
*Gaia Carenini,Cameron Seth*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: A tester decides whether a graph has a property or is far from having it. A distance estimator asks for more: it must approximately determine how many edges need to be changed. A property is said to be testable if there is a tester with a number of queries bounded independently of the graph's order for each conceivable distance. Similarly, if a property admits an estimator with a number of queries bounded independently of the graph's order, it is said to be estimable. Fischer and Newman proved that, in the dense graph model, every testable property is also estimable. We show that the passage from testing to estimation requires only a polynomial increase in query complexity. This resolves a long-standing open problem in property testing, previously tackled by Fiat and Ron, by Hoppen, Kohayakawa, Lang, Lefmann, and Stagni, and by Gishboliner, Kushnir, and Shapira.

### [241] [Metric TSP in Sublinear Time: Breaking Two Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04283)
*Amir Azarmehr,Soheil Behnezhad*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The seminal result of Czumaj and Sohler [STOC'04] showed that a 2-approximation of the value of metric TSP can be obtained with sublinear queries. Whether sublinear algorithms can break the 2-approximation barrier has remained a major open problem. See problem 71 on this http URL . This paper resolves this open problem. We show there are fixed $\varepsilon, \delta > 0$ such that a $(2-\delta)$-approximation of metric TSP value can be obtained with $O(n^{2-\varepsilon})$ queries. Here $n$ is the number of vertices, and the input size is $\Theta(n^2)$.

### [242] [State Evolution and Universality of Iterated Linear Programs for the Binary Perceptron](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04294)
*Jianan Zhang,Shuangping Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The binary perceptron is a random constraint satisfaction problem that asks for a sign vector satisfying a system of random linear inequalities. Its solution space has a strikingly extreme geometry: at every positive constraint density, all but a vanishing fraction of the solutions are isolated. Yet polynomial-time algorithms find solutions at small enough constraint density, which raises the question of how efficient algorithms navigate such a landscape. Linear programming is a natural algorithm to study here, but its analysis has so far been limited to a single round. Li, Schramm, and Zhou (STOC 2025) analyzed one linear program followed by iterative rounding. In this work, we overcome this limitation and give a precise analysis of iterated linear programming for the binary perceptron. (1) For Gaussian matrices and any fixed number of rounds, we characterize the iterated linear programs exactly through a deterministic state-evolution recursion. (2) Adding a final rounding step, we obtain a randomized polynomial-time algorithm for the binary perceptron. Numerical evaluations of the recursion provide evidence that it succeeds at constraint density $\alpha=0.60$ with zero margin, well beyond the range $\alpha\le0.1$ guaranteed by the single-LP analysis and $\alpha\approx0.327$ (Jo and Lee, 2026), the best guarantee so far. (3) We establish universality, showing that the same characterization holds for matrices with i.i.d. entries drawn from any centered, unit-variance subgaussian law. The key idea of our proof is that, although conditioning on earlier rounds makes the matrix non-Gaussian, its conditional law can be computed explicitly and remains close to a Gaussian law, so the convex Gaussian min-max theorem applies in every round. For universality, we compare Gaussian and subgaussian matrices through the Lindeberg principle, using a regularized version of each linear program.

### [243] [Gaussian Difference Dynamics: Breaking the $2^{n/2}$ Barrier for the Shortest Vector Problem and Discrete Gaussian Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04336)
*Yiming Gao,Xuyuan Han,Honggang Hu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give classical randomized algorithms in a word RAM model that break the $2^{n/2}$ barrier for both discrete Gaussian sampling (DGS) and the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP). For every fixed $\alpha>1$, shifted DGS on arbitrary lattices at width $\sigma\ge\alpha\eta_{1/2}(L)$ takes $$ (3/2)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad (4/3)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ These bounds match the Becker--Ducas--Gama--Laarhoven (BDGL) heuristic sieving exponents. At widths at least $3\eta_{1/2}(L)/2$, the same total cost suffices for an entire batch of $\lfloor(4/3)^{n/2}\rfloor$ samples jointly close to independent target Gaussians. For SVP on arbitrary lattices, our algorithm returns a shortest nonzero vector with high probability in $$ 2^{0.4130n+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad 2^{0.3138n+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ As a corollary, we obtain centered DGS at every width with the same exponents, answering a question of Stephens-Davidowitz (SODA 2016). We introduce Gaussian difference dynamics (GDD), a framework for tracking expected counts and pairwise clustering of vectors through repeated differencing. A closed recursion for the first two counting moments controls these quantities relative to a Gaussian reference, without requiring independence within intermediate lists. Accurate moment bounds let us extract a Gaussian sample by weighted selection, while the weaker bounds needed to establish a shortest vector representation allow us to retain more differences. We perform these transitions on thin spherical shells, where the Gaussian rejection weights can be renormalized at subexponential cost. For batch sampling, we combine this geometry with the double rejection technique of Doulgerakis and Laarhoven to control the joint distribution of outputs while reusing vectors.

### [244] [XOR-Functions and Beyond in the Random Query Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04353)
*Sumegha Garg,Janani Sundaresan,Santhoshini Velusamy*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study time--space tradeoffs for computing Boolean functions $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ in the random query model. On input $x$, a branching program receives independent samples $(i,x(i))$, where $i$ is uniform in $[n]$. We want to evaluate $f(x)$ while minimizing the width $2^S$ and the length $T$ of the branching program. There is a simple upper bound of $T = \tilde{O}(n)$, $S = O(n)$: coupon-collector shows that $\tilde{O}(n)$ samples suffice, and they can be stored in $O(n)$ space. Raz and Zhan (ITCS 2020) introduced this model and studied the zero-error setting. In the bounded-error setting, Dinur (SODA 2024) proved $TS = \tilde{\Omega}(n \cdot inf[f])$, where $inf[f]$ is the total influence of $f$. For many functions with low influence such as Equality and Tribes, this lower bound can leave a substantial gap from the best known upper bounds. Our main result is a stronger lower bound of $T(S+\log T) = \Omega(n \cdot sens[g])$ for any XOR-function $g(x,y)= f(x \oplus y)$, where $sens[g]$ is the sensitivity of $g$. Through simple corollaries, we get tight nearly-quadratic time--space lower bounds for Tribes and Equality, despite their low influence. Our proof introduces a new notion of information complexity tailored to the random query model along with a corresponding direct-sum argument which may be of independent interest. Dinur also proved a tight bound of $TS = \Omega(n^2)$ for Majority, whose influence is only $\Theta(\sqrt{n})$, and asked whether an alternative characterization of Boolean functions could give a unified proof of tight results for a broader class of functions, including Majority. We answer this open question by proving $TS = \tilde{\Omega}(n \cdot dgn[f])$, where $dgn[f]$ is the degeneracy of the sensitivity graph of $f$ (for Majority, this is $\Theta(n)$). We also prove that this bound is tight for all symmetric functions up to logarithmic factors.

### [245] [Space-Optimal Algorithms for Spanning Forests in Dynamic Streams at Every Confidence Level: With and Without Deletion Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04365)
*Zemin Chao,Jianhe Cen,Hengzhao Ma,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We characterize the optimal space for one-pass spanning-forest computation in dynamic streams of $v$-vertex simple graphs with failure probability at most $\delta$. Nelson and Yu proved an $\Omega(v\log^2v\log(v/\delta))$-bit lower bound, establishing the AGM algorithm's optimality for each fixed $0<\epsilon<1$ and $2^{-v^{1-\epsilon}}<\delta\le1/4$. We resolve the remaining high-confidence regime: for every $0<\delta\le1/4$, matching lower bounds and an algorithm give \[ \Theta\!\left(\min\left\{v^2,\;v\log(v/\delta)\log^2\!\left(2+\frac{v}{\log(v/\delta)}\right)\right\}\right) \] bits, improving space by up to a factor of $\Theta((\log v/\log\log v)^2)$ in this regime. We also study streams with at most $Z$ previously inserted edges deleted and not yet reinserted at report time, where the integer $Z\ge0$ is given in advance. Total deletions, restorations, and intermediate absence counts are unrestricted. For a single report and every $0<\delta\le1/4$, matching lower bounds and a one-pass randomized algorithm yield optimal space $\Theta(\mathcal L(v,Z,\log(1/\delta)))$ bits, where $x_Z(t)=\min\{Z+1,v,\sqrt{vt}\}$ and \[ \mathcal L(v,Z,t)=v\log v\min\{\log^2v,\log^2(Z+2)\} +vt\log\!\left(1+\frac{x_Z(t)}t\right)\log\!\left(1+\frac v{x_Z(t)}\right). \] At zero error, a lower bound for all zero-error algorithms and a matching deterministic algorithm give optimal space \[ \Theta\!\left(\min\{v^2,v(Z+1)\log(1+v/(Z+1))\}\right) \] bits. Together, these results characterize the memory required across all confidence levels and report-time edge-loss bounds.

### [246] [Binary Huffman Coding with Unequal Letter Costs Is NP-Complete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04444)
*L. Sunil Chandran,Rishikesh Gajjala*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Binary prefix coding assigns prefix-free binary words to symbols to minimize their frequency-weighted cost. Huffman solved the equal-letter-cost case in polynomial time in 1952 [Proc. IRE'52]. For unequal letter costs, Karp gave an integer-programming formulation in 1961 [IRE Trans. Inf. Theory'61]. Exact polynomial-time algorithms for fixed integer costs were given by Golin and Rote [IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory'98] and Bradford, Golin, Larmore, and Rytter [J. Algorithms'02]. For input-dependent costs, Golin, Mathieu, and Young gave a polynomial-time approximation scheme [SICOMP'12]. The exact complexity when letter costs are part of the input had remained unresolved. We resolve this $65$-year-old problem by proving that deciding whether there exists a binary prefix-free code of frequency-weighted cost at most a given threshold is NP-complete, even when the letter costs are consecutive positive integers $(M,M+1)$ supplied as part of the input. All frequencies, letter costs, and thresholds are encoded in binary. Consequently, finding an optimal code is NP-hard. Our proof uses two polynomial-time reductions, starting from Planar Independent Set. The intermediate problem prescribes the number of leaves at each depth of a full ordered binary tree and minimizes a signed linear score on their sorted right-edge counts. The first reduction represents an independent-set verification program by a tree growing level by level. A fixed-profile identity converts narrow coordinate restrictions into linear penalties that enforce the computation. The second reduction adds large dyadic terms to the symbol frequencies to force prescribed depths. These terms contribute a constant to the weighted number of ones, leaving smaller signed perturbations to reproduce the tree score.

### [247] [Dynamic Steiner Tree under Edge Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04506)
*Jeff Giliberti,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Mohammad Mahdavi,Xinchen Yang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The Steiner tree problem is the canonical generalization of minimum spanning tree (MST). When connectivity is required only among a fixed subset of vertices (terminals), the goal is to maintain a minimum-cost tree connecting these terminals as the graph undergoes edge updates. While dynamic MST has been studied since the 1980s~[Frederickson, STOC'83, SICOMP'85], and the first sublinear-in-$n$ dynamic MST algorithm dates back almost thirty-five years to Eppstein, Galil, Italiano, and Nissenzweig~[FOCS'92, JACM'97], achieving sublinear-in-$n$ update time for dynamic Steiner tree has long remained open, as a single edge update can invalidate many routes in the underlying terminal metric closure. We present the first fully dynamic algorithm for Steiner tree that achieves a constant-factor approximation with sublinear-in-$n$ update time. For any fixed $0<\zeta<1/2$, our deterministic algorithm maintains an $O_\zeta(1)$-approximate Steiner tree for undirected graphs with polynomially bounded edge weights in $\widetilde O(n^{1/2+\zeta})$ amortized update time, answering cost queries in $O(1)$ time, and reporting an explicit tree in $\widetilde O(n^{1+\zeta})$ time. Our approach combines periodic terminal-metric rebuilds on a dynamic spanner with a top-tree dynamic program that localizes edge deletions and reconnects surviving components through a dynamic distance sparsifier. Along the way, we give a simpler randomized insertion-only algorithm with a better, explicit approximation ratio.

### [248] [Distributionally Robust Search: The Power of Information and the Limits of Moments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04559)
*Nicole Megow,Cliff Stein,Jose Verschae*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study binary search for a target drawn from a distribution on $n$ ordered elements. The cost is the expected number of comparison queries. In our distributionally robust framework, the algorithm knows only an uncertainty set containing the distribution and minimizes its worst-case approximation ratio against an optimal strategy that knows the distribution. Collections of uncertainty sets capture different forms of information: quantiles, moments, general linear measurements, or approximate CDFs. This framework quantifies how much and what form of information is needed for near-optimal search. Our main result separates moments from general linear measurements. Although $n-1$ moments determine the distribution exactly, for every constant $\delta\in(0,1)$, the first $n^{1-\delta}$ exact moments can be as uninformative for search as no information: the worst-case approximation ratio remains $\Omega(\log n)$. In contrast, for every constant $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, $O(n^\varepsilon\log^4 n)$ suitably chosen linear measurements suffice for an $O(1/\varepsilon)$-approximation. The limitation lies in the measurements chosen, rather than linearity itself. Using LP duality and polynomial bounds of Rakhmanov and Bernstein, we construct distributions with identical moments and mass concentrated at different positions. For the upper bound, we combine dyadic sketches and Johnson--Lindenstrauss embeddings with a truncated median-search algorithm that converts uniform CDF approximation into search guarantees. Measuring information in bits, we prove a lower bound of $\Omega(1/\varepsilon)$ on the approximation ratio for summaries of any form using at most $\frac12 n^\varepsilon\log n$ bits, for every sufficiently small constant $\varepsilon>0$. Quantiles match this within constant factors. For Kolmogorov balls of radius $n^{-\varepsilon}$ the optimal approximation ratio is $\Theta(1/\varepsilon)$.

### [249] [First Near-Additive All-Pairs Approximate Shortest Paths in Decremental Weighted Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04635)
*Eden Koveshi,Liam Roditty,Ariel Sapir*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present the first four All-Pairs Approximate Shortest Paths (APASP) algorithms for decremental weighted undirected graphs. We extend the hierarchy induced edge sets of Baswana and Kavitha [FOCS'06 and SICOMP'10] to the decremental setting. At any point in time, for any $u,v$, $W_{i}$ denotes the weight of the $i$-th heaviest edge on any shortest path between them in the current graph. For any $\varepsilon>0$, our first algorithm maintains $(1+\varepsilon,2W_{2})$-APASP in $\tilde{O}(n^{\frac{3}{2}+o(1)}m^{\frac{1}{2}})$ total update time, matching a single static computation of Cohen and Zwick [SODA'97 and JALG'01], up to a subpolynomial factor. It also improves the stretch of the $(2+\varepsilon)$-APASP algorithm of Dory, Forster, Nazari and de Vos [ICALP'24]. Our second algorithm maintains $(1+\varepsilon,2W_{1}+2W_{2})$-APASP in $\tilde{O}(n^{\frac{7}{3}})$ total update time, improving upon Chechik's $(3+\varepsilon)$-APASP algorithm [FOCS'18] for $m=\Omega(n^{\frac{11}{6}})$. We also obtain two $(1+\varepsilon,2\cdot(k-1)W_{1})$-APASP algorithms with total update times $\tilde{O}(n^{2-\frac{1}{k}+o(1)}m^{\frac{1}{k}})$ and $\tilde{O}(n^{2+\frac{2}{3k-2}+o(1)})$, adapting the static $+2\sum_{i=1}^{k-1}W_{i}$-APASP algorithms of Cohen and Zwick [SODA'97 and JALG'01] and Roditty and Sapir [FSTTCS'25]. For unweighted graphs, we present $(1+\varepsilon,2)$-APASP in $\tilde{O}(n^{\frac{7}{3}})$ total update time and $(1+\varepsilon,2\cdot(k-1))$-APASP in $\tilde{O}(n^{2+\frac{1}{3k-4}+o(1)})$. Combined with the results of Dory, Forster, Nazari and de Vos [ICALP'24], these match the fastest combinatorial static bounds of Dor, Halperin and Zwick [FOCS'96 and SICOMP'00] up to subpolynomial factors.

### [250] [Glauber Dynamics for Sampling Colorings: Rapid Mixing above $(1+1/\mathrm{e})Δ$ via Hidden Hard-Core Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04699)
*Xiongxin Yang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We show that for every $\gamma>0$ and every sufficiently large $\Delta$, the Glauber dynamics for proper $q$-colorings of any $n$-vertex graph of maximum degree $\Delta$ has spectral gap $\Omega_\gamma(1/n)$, and hence mixing time $O_\gamma(n^2\log q)$, whenever $q\ge(1+1/\mathrm{e}+\gamma)\Delta$. Our proof establishes a Bochner-type inequality by exploiting the spectral gaps of hard-core models hidden in the color classes. The constant $1+1/\mathrm{e}\approx1.368$ comes from the uniqueness threshold $\approx\mathrm{e}/\Delta$ of the hard-core model on the infinite $\Delta$-regular tree.

### [251] [Pure Differentially Private Query Release via Laplace Input Smoothing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04721)
*Zongrui Zou*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the offline release of a public family of $k$ statistical queries on a database of $N$ records from a public universe of size $d$, under pure $\varepsilon$-differential privacy. We give an efficient algorithm that, with probability at least $1-\beta$, answers all queries simultaneously to error $$O\left(\min\left\{1,\sqrt{\frac{\log(d/\beta)\log k}{N\varepsilon}}\right\}\right).$$ The output is a synthetic histogram on the data universe, and its running time depends polynomially on $N,d$ and $k$. This resolves a conjecture of Nikolov and Ullman (2021) with an efficient, polynomial-time construction. Fitzsimons (2026) recently established the same square-root error scale via an information-theoretic construction that relies on a computationally intractable Lipschitz envelope over the exponential space of possible outputs. In contrast, we introduce an input-side smoothing approach: we run a selection-only multiplicative-weights process after a single sparse Laplace perturbation of the input histogram. Departing from standard first-order stability analyses, we investigate the stability of stability by establishing a uniform lower bound on the second-order log-derivatives of the output transcript across $T$ rounds of multiplicative weight updates. We then develop an analytic smoothing principle showing that this curvature bound allows a sparse, coordinate-wise perturbation to guarantee pure differential privacy globally, attaining optimal utility through a conceptually simple, polynomial-time pure-DP mechanism.

### [252] [Tree Covers for Directed Graphs: Distance Oracles, Routing Schemes and Spanners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04731)
*Shiri Chechik,Gur Lifshitz*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In a seminal work [STOC'01; JACM'05], Thorup and Zwick showed that every weighted undirected graph admits a tree cover where each vertex belongs to $O(kn^{1/k})$ trees in expectation, and every pair has a path of stretch at most $2k-1$ in some tree. In this paper, we extend this structural property to directed graphs with nonnegative edge weights. Let $\mathrm{dist}_G(u \leftrightarrows v) = \mathrm{dist}_G(u \to v) + \mathrm{dist}_G(v \to u)$ denote the roundtrip distance. For every integer $k$, we construct a collection $\mathcal{T}$ of tree-pairs, each consisting of an in-tree and an out-tree rooted at the same vertex. Each vertex belongs to $O(kn^{1/k})$ tree-pairs in expectation, and for every ordered pair $(u, v)$ some tree-pair $T_{in}\cup T_{out} \in \mathcal{T}$ satisfies $\mathrm{dist}_{T_{in}\cup T_{out}}(u \to v) \le \mathrm{dist}_G(u \to v) + (k-1)\mathrm{dist}_G(u \leftrightarrows v).$ We call this a \emph{$k$-strong (roundtrip) tree cover}. While prior techniques partition distances into geometric scales and build separate structures for each scale, our construction handles all distances simultaneously within a single, unified hierarchy. This yields the first directed tree cover for general $k$ matching the classic Thorup-Zwick stretch-size trade-off. Our cover immediately implies improved constructions of roundtrip spanners, path-reporting distance oracles, and compact routing schemes, as well as their source-wise and prioritized variants. We also provide faster algorithms for these structures: for general $k \ge 4$, all the above objects can be constructed in $\widetilde{O}(\min\{mn, n^{2.5}\})$ expected time, breaking the $mn$ barrier in dense directed graphs.

### [253] [Smallest Multiplicative Stretch for an $α$-APASP Below $\widetilde O \left(n^ω\right)$ Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04736)
*Lakshay Saggi,Ariel Sapir*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Dor, Halperin and Zwick [FOCS'96; SICOMP'00] showed that $(2-\varepsilon)$-APASP is at least as hard as BMM for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<1$. Zwick [FOCS'98; JACM'02] gave a $2$-APASP algorithm in $\widetilde O(n^{\omega+o(1)}\log W_{\max})$ runtime, where $W_{\max}$ is the maximum edge weight. Bringmann, K{ü}nnemann and W{ę}grzycki [STOC'19] removed this logarithmic factor. Using OpenAI's recent bound $\omega\leq\frac{9}{4}$ gives $\widetilde O\left(n^{\frac{9}{4}+o(1)}\right)$ time. We present two weighted undirected $2$-APASP algorithms. The first uses $(\min,\max)$-products. Earlier rectangular FMM bounds of Vassilevska Williams, Yinzhan Xu, Zixuan Xu and Zhou [SODA'24] and Alman, Duan, Vassilevska Williams, Yinzhan Xu, Zixuan Xu and Zhou [SODA'25] give $\widetilde O(n^{2.36999465})$ runtime, below the previous $\omega\leq2.371177$ of Dupont, Eisenberger, Kozlovskii, Mehrabian, Ruiz, See, Zhou, Alman, Vassilevska Williams and Balog [arXiv'26]. Current rectangular FMM bounds give $\widetilde O(n^{2.34549151})$, independent of $W_{\max}$. For integer weights, our second algorithm has $\widetilde O(n^{\omega-\frac{(\omega-2)^2}{\omega-1}+o(1)}\log^{O(1)}W_{\max})$ runtime, with exponent below $\omega$ whenever $\omega>2$. The rectangular bounds of Uzna{ń}ski [arXiv'26] or of Amanov, van den Berg and Zuiddam [arXiv'26] give $\widetilde O(n^{2.17157288}\log^{O(1)}W_{\max})$.

### [254] [Approximation Algorithms for Multi-Criteria Network Design Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04742)
*Mehrshad Taziki,Ali Vakilian*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Min-max multi-criteria optimization asks for a single feasible solution minimizing the maximum of its costs under $\ell$ nonnegative cost functions, a formulation that captures both fairness across groups and robustness across scenarios. It has proved hard to approximate even for basic problems: for robust shortest paths, polylogarithmic approximations are known only in quasi-polynomial time. For network design, the best known guarantee is an $\ell$-approximation, which is tight for the natural LP relaxation. We show that exponentially better and nearly optimal guarantees are achievable for two fundamental network design problems. For multi-criteria connectivity augmentation (MC-CAP), which asks to increase the edge connectivity of a given undirected graph by one, we give a randomized polynomial-time $O(\log \ell)$-approximation algorithm. Applying our augmentation procedure iteratively and analyzing its randomized choices jointly across iterations yields an $O(\log k \log \ell)$-approximation for the multi-criteria $k$-edge-connected spanning subgraph (MC-$k$-ECSS) problem, for every $k \geq 2$. We complement these algorithms with a nearly matching lower bound: for every fixed $\varepsilon > 0$, MC-CAP admits no polynomial-time $O(\log^{1-\varepsilon} \ell)$-approximation, even when the underlying graph is a star, unless $\mathsf{NP}\subseteq\mathsf{DTIME}\bigl(n^{\log^{O(1)}n}\bigr)$. The same hardness extends to the MC-$k$-ECSS problem.

For network design, the best known guarantee is an $\ell$-approximation, which is tight for the natural LP relaxation. We show that exponentially better and nearly optimal guarantees are achievable for two fundamental network design problems. For multi-criteria connectivity augmentation (MC-CAP), which asks to increase the edge connectivity of a given undirected graph by one, we give a randomized polynomial-time $O(\log \ell)$-approximation algorithm. Applying our augmentation procedure iteratively and analyzing its randomized choices jointly across iterations yields an $O(\log k \log \ell)$-approximation for the multi-criteria $k$-edge-connected spanning subgraph (MC-$k$-ECSS) problem, for every $k \geq 2$. We complement these algorithms with a nearly matching lower bound: for every fixed $\varepsilon > 0$, MC-CAP admits no polynomial-time $O(\log^{1-\varepsilon} \ell)$-approximation, even when the underlying graph is a star, unless $\mathsf{NP}\subseteq\mathsf{DTIME}\bigl(n^{\log^{O(1)}n}\bigr)$. The same hardness extends to the MC-$k$-ECSS problem.

</details>


### [255] [Optimal (Randomized) Compact Routing Schemes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04744)
*Shiri Chechik,Avi Kadria,Gur Lifshitz,Liam Roditty*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Compact routing schemes route messages along short paths while every vertex stores little information. We study the trade-off between the stretch and the storage of compact routing schemes in undirected graphs, in four models: labeled and name-independent schemes, with average or worst-case local storage. We improve the best known stretch in all four models. Our main result is a labeled routing scheme with expected stretch $2k-1$ and $\widetilde O(n^{1/k})$ average local storage, in which only the routing is randomized. Under the Erdős girth conjecture, no scheme with this storage has stretch below $2k-1$, so our scheme is optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors in the storage. With deterministic routing, we obtain stretch $\approx2.47k$, the best known deterministic stretch with average storage. Worst-case local storage is the classical setting of compact routing. The leading coefficient $4$ in the stretch $4k-5$ of Thorup and Zwick~[SPAA'01] was improved only by Chechik~[PODC'13], to $\approx3.68$ in unweighted graphs. In unweighted graphs, we obtain expected stretch $(\frac83k+O(1),O(k))$, and deterministic stretch $\approx3.05k$. Name-independent routing is harder, since the source knows only the name of the destination. The best known stretch with $\widetilde O(n^{1/k})$ local storage in unweighted graphs was $96k$, by Abraham, Gavoille, and Malkhi~[DISC'04]. We improve it by more than a factor of $8$. With average storage, we obtain expected stretch $4k-5$, which matches the labeled scheme of Thorup and Zwick. With worst-case storage in unweighted graphs, we obtain expected stretch $(8k+O(1),O(k))$. All our schemes for unweighted graphs extend to weighted graphs with a small loss in the stretch, and still improve the previous unweighted bounds.

### [256] [Testing for a Large Induced Expander: Sublinear Algorithms and Query Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04766)
*Pan Peng,Ranran Shen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Testing expansion asks to distinguish graphs of large conductance from graphs that are far from having large conductance. We study a relaxation in which only part of the graph is required to expand: does an $n$-vertex graph of bounded degree contain an induced expander on a constant fraction of its vertices, when the rest of the graph, including the edges leaving the expander, is arbitrary? Let $P_{\alpha,\phi}$ denote the property of containing an induced subgraph on at least $\alpha n$ vertices with inner conductance at least $\phi$. For every constant $\kappa\in(0,1)$, we give a tester that accepts graphs in $P_{\alpha,\phi}$ and rejects graphs outside $P_{\kappa\alpha,\mu\phi^2}$, where $\mu=\Theta_{\alpha,\kappa}(1/\log n)$, using $O_{\alpha,\kappa}(\sqrt n\,\phi^{-2}\log n)$ queries. For fixed $\alpha\in(0,1]$, $\kappa\in(0,1)$, and $0<\phi\le9/20$, we further show that distinguishing these two classes requires $\Omega_{\alpha,\kappa,\phi}(n^{1/2+c_{\kappa,\phi}\mu})$ queries for every sufficiently large $n$ and every $0<\mu\le1$, where $c_{\kappa,\phi}>0$. The bound holds for adaptive algorithms, uniformly in $\mu$. Hence, for testers with $\sqrt n\,\mathrm{polylog}(n)$ queries, the logarithmic loss in conductance is necessary up to a $\log\log n$ factor. The same tester also permits distance-based rejection at a weaker conductance while retaining the original core size. Our tester compares the endpoint distributions of random walks from different vertices with each other, rather than with the uniform distribution. Its analysis uses the trace chain, which observes the walk only at its visits to the unknown expanding core. Our lower bound builds on the noisy-parity construction of [CKK+18], using vector-valued parity labels in $\mathbb F_2^r$ to create many hidden classes, each too small to contain a qualifying induced expander.

### [257] [Differentially Oblivious Priority Queues with Sublogarithmic Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04776)
*Zimai Guo,Cheng Hong,Zhechen Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper, we study exact online integer priority queues under differential obliviousness in the balls-and-bins model. Given a public upper bound $T$ on the number of operations and assuming that the priorities are bounded by a polynomial in $T$, we construct an $(\eps,\delta)$-differentially oblivious priority queue supporting insertion and minimum extraction, which requires $\polylog(T)$ private memory. For constant $\varepsilon>0$ and $\delta=\exp(-\Theta(\log^2 T))$, our construction incurs $O(\log T/\log\log T)$ expected amortized total work per operation, which breaks the $\Omega(\log T)$ barrier for fully oblivious priority queues~[Jacob et al., SODA'2019]. Further, we prove a matching lower bound for $(\eps,\delta)$-differentially oblivious priority queues with $\varepsilon=O(1)$ and $\delta=o(1)$, which indicates that our construction is asymptotically optimal in terms of total work.

### [258] [Optimal Approximation for Constrained Correlation Clustering via Repulsion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04784)
*Yixin Cao,Ying Xu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The best-known approximation factor for constrained correlation clustering stood at three for nearly two decades, until a recent improvement to below $16/7$. We give a randomized polynomial-time $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation using \emph{Repulsion}, a recursive operation that separates a metric ball from its complement. Repulsion naturally respects hard constraints and admits a short potential-based analysis; as a warm-up, radius-$2/3$ Repulsion rounds the standard metric LP into a feasible partition of cost at most three times its objective. The $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation takes a two-stage approach, first removing must-links with arbitrarily small loss in the approximation ratio. The second stage combines lossless, constraint-aware preclustering with the bounded sub-cluster LP framework of Cao, Cohen-Addad, Lee, Li, Newman, and Vogl (STOC 2024). Repeated positive conditioning and sampling produce candidate sets, which radius-one Repulsion partitions into feasible clusters at controlled cost. We also give an approximation-preserving reduction from vertex cover to cluster deletion, a special case with only cannot-links. Apart from establishing a matching factor-two hardness threshold under the Unique Games Conjecture, it motivates our two-stage approach and Repulsion.

### [259] [Near-linear-Time Sampling of the Ferromagnetic Ising Model at the Tree Uniqueness Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04786)
*Tianshun Miao*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give a near-linear-time sampler for the zero-field ferromagnetic Ising model throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, including the threshold itself. The method also gives sampling algorithms for the XY and integer Potts models. On an $n$-vertex graph with $m$ edges and maximum degree at most $\Delta$, we obtain the following expected-work bounds, with total variation error at most $\varepsilon$. this http URL -linear Ising sampling. For $\Delta\ge3$, the work is $O(n+m\log^3(n/\varepsilon))$ throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, including the threshold $\beta=\Delta/(\Delta-2)$. this http URL -linear XY sampling. For $\Delta\ge8$, we sample the XY model in $\widetilde O(m+n^{1+o(1)})$ expected work at inverse-polynomial accuracy up to and including the robust phase-transition threshold on the $\Delta$-regular tree. this http URL -linear Potts sampling. For integer $q\ge3$, we sample the $q$-state Potts model in $\widetilde O(n+q^{O(1)}m)$ expected work whenever $\beta-1\le 0.1(\beta_{\mathrm{od}}(q,\Delta)-1)$, where $\beta_{\mathrm{od}}$ is the ordered/disordered coexistence parameter. We express the even-subgraph representation of critical Ising as a polymer model that admits near-linear-time sampling, thereby bypassing the critical slowdown of Glauber and Swendsen--Wang dynamics. Building on the low-degree approximation approach of Miao and Yin, we establish general spectral conditions for fast polymer sampling. We verify these conditions through explorations that also implement the sampler efficiently, and apply the same framework to flow representations of the XY and Potts models. We also establish polynomial-time counting and sampling for the ferromagnetic XY model at every fixed temperature.
