Motivation: 随着通用大语言模型（如 Gemini、DeepSeek）推理能力持续增强，一个关键问题浮现：这些模型的材料属性预测能力与领域专用的材料预训练模型（如 SteelBERT、MatSciBERT、SciBERT）相比究竟如何？若通用 LLM 已具备相当甚至更优的能力，则昂贵且需大量领域语料/标注的领域预训练的必要性将大幅下降。此外，纯 LLM 直接预测在数值回归任务中精度受限，亟需引入先验模型的数值信息作为引导；同时材料数据普遍存在噪声与冗余，数据选择策略（质量 vs 数量）对少样本/低成本场景至关重要，而模型预测的可信度评估也影响实际材料发现的决策可靠性。

Method: 1) 任务与体系：面向 Ti、钢、高熵合金（HEA）、Al 等多类材料的属性预测，评测对象包括通用 LLM（DeepSeek V3.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash）与领域专用模型（SteelBERT、MatSciBERT、SciBERT）。2) 混合（hybrid）框架：采用"无引导模式（unguided mode）"与"引导模式"对比；引导模式将先验模型（CatBoost、SteelBERT）输出的数值先验估计作为提示（prompt）输入 LLM，使 LLM 承担"推理校正器（reasoning corrector）"角色，对先验数值进行修正与细化。3) 数据策略：引入基于相似度的度量指标，考察参考数据的选择（高质量高相似度子集 vs 全量训练集），量化数据质量与数量的贡献（5% 高相似度数据 vs 100% 训练集）。4) 不确定性分析：利用 LLM 自报置信度（如"high confidence"）与预测值相对真值偏差（deviation from ground truth）之间的相关性来评估校准性。

Result: 1) 通用 LLM 在材料属性预测上"意外地"优于 SteelBERT、MatSciBERT 与 SciBERT，说明其隐含的物理化学与材料知识在数值回归任务中已被有效激活。2) 混合模式最优：先验模型数值作为提示时，LLM 校正后的精度同时超过先验模型自身与无引导模式，验证了"数值先验 + 语义推理校正"的互补性。3) 数据质量主导数量：仅使用训练集中 5% 的高相似度参考数据作为输入，性能即可与使用 100% 训练集相当，表明高质量数据策展比扩大数据规模更有效。4) 不确定性校准良好：LLM 自报"高置信度"的样本与相对真值的极小偏差强相关，置信度声明具备实际指示意义，可用于下游筛选与风险控制。

Conclusion: 通用大语言模型在材料属性预测上可超越领域专用预训练材料模型；将先验模型（CatBoost、SteelBERT）给出的数值基线作为提示输入 LLM、令其充当推理校正器，可获得优于任一单独方案的精度；配合基于相似度的高质量数据策展（5% 足矣），并利用 LLM 可靠的置信度自报机制进行不确定性评估，可形成一种低成本、高准确率的材料发现范式，从而显著降低对昂贵领域专用预训练的依赖。该范式的核心启示是"通用 LLM + 数值先验 + 数据质量优先"的协同组合，而非单纯扩大模型或数据规模。

Abstract: As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. Additionally, the LLMs demonstrate excellent uncertainty calibration, where self-reported "high" confidence strongly correlates with minimal deviation from ground truth. Our findings suggest that synergizing general-purpose LLMs with prior model numerical baselines and high-quality data curation creates a cost-effective and accurate paradigm for materials discovery, reducing the need for expensive domain-specific pretraining.

</details>


### [349] [Probabilistic Steering of Generative Priors for Lab-in-the-Loop Antibody Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03844)
*Anisha Parsan,Sebastian Ober,Calvin McCarter,Nick Bhattacharya,Hunter Elliott*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CHAD（Calibrated Handoff via Acquisition-guided Diffusion）：把「生成式发现」与「迭代优化」两阶段统一到一个框架中——冻结一个序列-结构流匹配生成模型（Proteina-Complexa）作为先验，在去噪过程中用 Feynman-Kac (FK) steering 以代理模型（高斯过程）的采集函数 logPI 作为重采样势能，从而按轮次自动完成「先验探索 → 代理模型利用」的交接。实验在三个抗体改造（VHH–PT、scFv–SARS-CoV-2、Trastuzumab–HER2）的 in-silico 主动学习模拟中显示：低 N 阶段数据效率更优、优于纯序列 GA 组合优化（OberBO）与 LaMBO 基线，同时保持开发性质（pI、GRAVY、OASis）不劣；用采集函数（而非仅后验均值）作为奖励能产生约两倍多的唯一高分设计，且 CDR 空间覆盖（#Circles AUC）优于均值引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 治疗性抗体开发通常被割裂为两阶段：先是生成式结构模型做 de novo 发现（命中率低、亲和力多为微摩尔级），再由一套基于湿实验数据训练的监督代理模型做黑盒优化（BO）来精炼 hit。这种割裂带来两个问题：(1) de novo 先验擅长 N=0，监督代理在数据累积后才逐渐可靠，低 N 区间（N 很小）效率低下，而湿实验每轮成本极高，因此「每次测量带来的适应度增益」至关重要；(2) 两套模型/技术栈割裂，交接不自然，无法在一个统一模型中同时兼顾探索与利用。作者希望有一个模型横跨两个 regime：带校准交接的生成先验。

Method: 核心方法为推理时（inference-time）的粒子引导，无需微调生成模型：
1) 先验 p_θ 采用目标条件化的序列-结构流匹配模型 Proteina-Complexa，每个残基状态为 α-碳坐标 + 8 维隐变量（由冻结自编码器解码为氨基酸）；T=400 步，闭式干净估计 x̂₁ = x_t + (1−t)v_θ(x_t,t)，仅在 CDR 位置 ℐ 上重设计（其余位置每步回写父本坐标与隐变量）。
2) FK steering：维持 P 个粒子，在若干中间去噪步按势能 G_r(x̂₁)=exp(λ a_r(x)) 做多项式重采样（采样即 potential，immediate potential，不累积轨迹奖励），以逼近奖励倾斜分布 p_r(x) ∝ p_θ(x)exp(λ a_r(x))。
3) 奖励 a_r 采用不确定性导出的采集函数：每轮从零重拟合的高斯过程代理 g_r（CDR one-hot 特征 + Tanimoto 核）给出后验均值 μ_r 与标准差 σ_r，logPI = log Φ((μ_r−y*_r)/σ_r)，其中 y*_r 为已测设计的后验均值最大值。这使 FK 势能继承代理模型的后验不确定性。
4) 批次构建：对 K 次 steered sweep 的候选池用 qHSRI（在 (μ,σ) 的 Pareto 前沿上按 Sharpe 比率排序）选出 B 个设计实测；下一轮用上一轮按预测值取前 q=0.2 再按 CDR Hamming 距离贪心选出的多样化 incumbents 作为种子（warm start），γ 控制偏离父本程度（γ=0 为 de novo，实验用 γ=0.75）。
5) 基线：BoN（同 FK 设置但 T_rs=null，无重采样）、OberBO（纯序列 GA 组合优化，c-onehot-T 预设，每轮最多 3 个 CDR 编辑）、LaMBO（潜空间 EI 引导的离散扩散 BO，用相同 round-0 种子 warm start）。
6) 评估：三个已完成的真实 campaign 上回放主动学习循环，用固定的 in-silico oracle（VHH–PT：10×CARP/ByteNet 集成，BLI 微调，测试 Spearman 0.71；SARS-CoV-2：残差膨胀 1D-CNN + AbLang2 嵌入，Spearman 0.858；HER2：CNN 分类器，ROC-AUC 0.995）替代湿实验；起点为 campaign 内的分布内父本（HER2 用 50% 随机化 CDR-H3 的弱化父本）。

Result: 1) 数据效率：CHAD（FK, λ=1）在三个 target 上每轮平均适应度上升更快，且在 HER2 上最快达到 p(binder) 上限；汇总表显示 CHAD 在每个 target 上都取得最佳单设计（PT 5.1×、SARS 119.3×）与最佳 top-10 均值（4.8×、115.4×、1.000），超过父本的设计比例也最高（91±1%、94±1%、86±2%）；OberBO 相对最弱（PT 4.0×、SARS 100.7×），LaMBO 在 SARS 上退化至 60.7×，且 LaMBO/OberBO 常无法在匹配算力下产生 1056 个唯一设计。2) 多样性：采集函数引导相比仅用后验均值引导，产生约两倍的唯一高分候选，且 #Circles 的 AUC 比为 1.20–1.51×，说明采集加权避免坍缩到少数高分序列；不过 CHAD 并未在任一 campaign 上取得最高 CDR 多样性（多样性服务于探索而非目标）。3) 开发性质：用非抗体专用先验的 CHAD 在 pI∈[7,9]、GRAVY<0、OASis 等标准指标上与基线大致持平（如 SARS OASis 0.451 vs OberBO 0.502）。4) 序列空间探索：MDS 嵌入显示 FK/BoN 占据与 OberBO（在 3 个 target 中有 2 个）基本不重叠的区域，且共享热点位置的替换氨基酸身份差异显著，说明不同方法可组成互补的方法组合。5) 控制变量：降低 warm-start γ、提高粒子数会扩大唯一设计池并提升多样性；提高 steering 强度 λ 与重采样频率则使群体集中到高奖励设计，提供奖励-多样性权衡的多个杠杆。

Conclusion: CHAD 证明可以通过「把代理模型的采集函数作为 FK 重采样势能」来平滑地把生成先验过渡为迭代优化器，在三个多样化的抗体格式与 in-silico campaign 中以更少的实测设计获得更高适应度，且不损害通用开发性质，并保持先验带来的结构/序列多样性。局限：种子来自 campaign 而非 de novo 发现 hit，无法复现目标场景；评估依赖学习型 in-silico oracle 而非湿实验亲和力，可能被训练分布外的 exploit，因此仍需湿实验验证。未来工作：追踪 σ_r 随轮次的收缩以更好刻画不确定性的作用；将标量引导接口扩展到多目标（如 Pareto 感知的 EHVI）；探索基于可微代理的梯度引导；以及替换非抗体专用的生成架构而无需改动方法框架。

Abstract: Therapeutic antibody development is often framed as comprising two discrete stages: initial discovery of novel binders followed by iterative optimization to refine these hits into therapeutic-grade molecules. Models and methods often reflect these stages, with generative structure models applied to discovery and probabilistic black-box optimization methods applied to refinement. Here we propose to unify these stages by smoothly transitioning a generative discovery model into iterative optimization, allowing the handoff between the structure-based prior and supervision from wet lab data to be guided by the posterior uncertainty of a probabilistic surrogate. We show that this yields improvements in optimization efficiency in the low-N regime, as well as improved diversity amongst the optimized molecules.

</details>


### [350] [Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03862)
*Farid Hasanov,Riccardo Renzulli,Bahram Zonooz,Mykola Pechenizkiy,Decebal Constantin Mocanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出「Dr. No」：一种免训练的推理时特征引导（feature steering）方法，通过挖掘稀疏自编码器（SAE）中与「弃答」和「承诺作答」相关的稀疏特征，在 prefill 阶段对这些特征的解码方向做加性干预，从而在不重训基座模型的前提下控制模型的弃答行为。在 LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B（UNK-VQA、MM-UPD）与 Qwen3.5-2B（AbstentionBench）上，相比后验不确定性拒绝（MSP、熵、log-prob、P(True)、语义熵、verbalized confidence）取得更优的「作答—弃答」权衡，但增益高度依赖不可答来源：对「图像—问题/答案集不兼容」类最有效，对「正确选项缺失」（AAD）与检索型多跳问答（MuSiQue）效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在证据不足时仍倾向于自信作答（训练/评测流程普遍奖励生成答案），在医疗、司法等高风险或信息检索场景中「自信但无依据的回答」比不回答更糟。现有弃答方法几乎都是「后验拒绝」：从输出层面估计不确定性（最大softmax概率、熵、序列log-prob、自评估P(True)、verbalized confidence、采样语义熵），再用一个标量阈值决定是否拒绝。这本质上是单一自由度控制，难以同时维持可答题的作答准确率与不可答题的弃答率，且阈值选取敏感。作者提出的核心问题：弃答/承诺这一行为是否存在可识别、可在推理时操控的内部机制？稀疏自编码器将残差流分解为可解释的稀疏特征，若弃答被部分编码在这些特征上，则少量特征即可作为「轻量控制把手」。此前相近工作（ITI、safety refusal direction、SAVE、CLIP-UP）分别面向真值性/安全性拒答/物体幻觉/外部CLIP兼容性信号，尚未针对「认知性弃答（epistemic abstention）」这一不同边界做特征级控制，且无法迁移到纯语言场景。

Method: 方法分三步，且基座模型与SAE全程冻结。(1) 构建带标签的挖掘语料：多模态侧基于GQA balanced训练集，取5000个可答样本并用四种扰动各生成5000个不可答样本（semantic drift换图、object absence用场景图问不存在物体、false premise植入视觉无依据假设、answer dropping移除正确选项并回填干扰项），共25000条多选题，四个选项位随机置换以避免固定弃答槽位；文本侧直接用Synthetic Unanswerable Math (SUM)（20000可答+20000不可答）。(2) 特征挖掘：在各候选层提取决策位置（最后prompt token）的残差流激活，经SAE编码为稀疏激活；先做行为过滤（仅保留未引导模型真正选中弃答项的样本用于挖掘弃答特征、正确选中答案的样本用于挖掘承诺特征），用均值激活差 Δ_j 与单特征AUROC对特征排序，得到弃答特征集 A 与承诺特征集 C，各取top-k。(3) 推理时干预：将所选特征的SAE解码方向做L2归一化后求和得 v_A、v_C，构造 v(m,α)=α(s_A v_A − s_C v_C)，含abstention-up / commitment-down / bidirectional三种模式；主配置采用门控版本，由同一批弃答特征在决策token的平均激活 u(x) 经 sigmoid((u−τ)/T) 映射为 g(x)∈[0,1]（τ取弃答/承诺读数均值中点，T取两者差值/4），在prefill阶段对目标层所有prompt token位置（含图像token）加 g(x)·v，生成token不干预。超参（层16/20/24或15/18/21、k∈{1,3,5}、α∈{1..5}、模式、门控）在与后验基线相同的验证集上选定后固定。此外提供两个无字典基线：logit bias（对弃答选项logit加标量偏置）与dense steering（同一公式但直接作用于原始残差流）。评价指标包括可答/不可答准确率、其调和平均HM，以及MM-UPD的standard/UPD/dual accuracy。

Result: UNK-VQA（LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B）：Dr. No 最佳HM=38.7（可答31.5/不可答50.3），优于最佳后验基线（MSP 36.5、P(True) 37.3、log-prob 36.7等）与dense steering 38.2、logit bias 36.3；弃答提示基线不可答率升至93.8但可答率崩至6.1（HM 11.5），呈粗粒度全局拒答。MM-UPD：增益按不可答来源分化——IASD dual 45.5、IVQD dual 57.6 提升明显，而AAD dual 30.2 低于最强后验基线（约41.3），因AAD属「选项集核验」而非内在不可答。AbstentionBench（Qwen3.5-2B，数学子集均值）：HM=77.6 为最佳，优于无引导71.1、弃答提示74.2、最佳后验76.1；三个数学子集（MMLU-Math/UMWP/GSM8K）HM分别达68.8/77.1/85.5均为最优，主要来自不可答召回提升且基本保留可答准确率；但MuSiQue HM=59.9 略低于基线61.1，属检索密集型多跳问答的失效模式。消融：随机SAE特征降至HM 35.6/MM-UPD 38.1，commitment-down单独36.3，abstention-up单独38.2，双向最优，说明收益源自具体挖掘方向而非泛化扰动，且「提升弃答激活」贡献大于「抑制承诺方向」。α扫描显示UNK-VQA最优α=5（38.7），MM-UPD最优α=2（对过引导更敏感）。鲁棒性：10,000次配对bootstrap给出UNK-VQA HM 38.7 [38.00,39.46] vs 基线35.2 [34.59,35.84]；三个挖掘种子的top-5特征集合完全一致、Spearman秩相关0.933–1.000、下游指标标准差仅0.02–0.13，说明特征挖掘随机性远小于评测采样噪声。弃答措辞改写（"Unanswerable"→"图像信息不足"等）后HM稳定提升3.3–3.6点，排除表层token偏好。开销极小：每轮+8ms（+1.0%），其中SAE编码2.1ms，峰值显存+0.5GiB。Qwen3.5-2B在多模态基准上复现同样模式（UNK-VQA HM 39.6最佳，AAD仍最难），说明AAD是跨backbone的通用失效模式。

Conclusion: 稀疏内部特征可为冻结模型的弃答行为提供轻量、可解释、可操控的控制把手，SAE特征引导在「作答—弃答」权衡上优于后验不确定性拒绝与提示式拒答，且开销可忽略。但弃答并非由单一通用方向支配：其有效性强烈依赖不可答的来源类型——特征挖掘语料中的「不兼容」模式迁移良好（IASD/IVQD、数学推理），而「正确选项缺失」（AAD）与需跨跳检索组合的MuSiQue需要不同（甚至跨推理步骤）的信号。作者提出未来方向：从多样不可答来源挖掘特征、发展自适应选择与引导策略、将特征级干预与校准不确定性结合。伦理上该机制具双刃性（可被反向用于压制谨慎或放大 indiscriminate refusal），在跨语言/子群体/视觉域上的弃答分布尚未审计，故不应视为普适安全检测器，高风险部署前需人工监督下的分群审计。

Abstract: Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. This failure to abstain makes them hard to trust in high-stakes or information-seeking settings, where a confident but unsupported answer can be worse than no answer at all. It also raises a natural question: can the internal mechanisms behind this behaviour be identified and controlled at inference time? We present Dr. No, a feature-steering approach that mines sparse autoencoder (SAE) features associated with abstention and commitment, then modulates a small set of them during the prefill pass, without retraining the base model. Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. Against multiple uncertainty-based abstention baselines, feature steering achieves a more favourable balance between correct answering and appropriate abstention than post-hoc rejection methods. The gains are strongest on UNK-VQA and on MM-UPD cases involving image--question or question--answer incompatibility, and transfer most clearly to mathematical reasoning subsets of AbstentionBench. However, performance is more limited on absent-answer detection and retrieval-heavy multi-hop QA, such as MuSiQue. These results suggest that sparse internal features provide lightweight control handles for shaping uncertainty-aware behaviour in foundation models, while also showing that abstention control is source-dependent rather than governed by a single universal signal.

</details>


### [351] [ExaTune: Exhaustive Hyperparameter Landscape Exploration at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03867)
*Kevin Dick,Katie Lonsway*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExaTune：一个开源的高性能计算（HPC/SLURM）系统，把声明式 YAML 配置展开为完整的超参数笛卡尔网格，用 K 折交叉验证穷举评估每一个网格点，聚合为可复现的 Parquet 文件，从而生成一种新的科学制品——"超参数景观图"（hyperparameter landscape map）。作者同时给出一套从进化计算"适应度景观分析"（fitness landscape analysis）迁移到超参数空间的五类形式化指标（Moran 空间自相关 ℐ、崎岖度 R、局部最优密度 δ_O、漏斗指数 φ_ε、适应度-距离相关 FDC，以及方差分解参数重要性 η²_k 与参数交互强度 Ω），并发布包含 8 张完整景观图（覆盖 285,080 个配置、5 个模型族、6 个分类 + 2 个回归任务）的基准集合（HuggingFace + Croissant 元数据）。核心结论是：100 次试验预算下的随机搜索、贝叶斯优化、Hyperband、Optuna(TPE) 仅覆盖网格的 0.09%–2.06%，虽然返回的最优配置性能已接近全局最优，但会系统性遗漏不稳定悬崖、次级最优盆地与参数交互结构——这类信息按设计就是任何优化器无法提供的；代价是穷举的算力与碳排放高出约 1000–17,000 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超参数优化（HPO）把性能函数 f:Λ→ℝ 当作黑盒，只为在有限预算内找到单个最优点，优化结束后整个性能面被丢弃。但该景观本身编码了重要科学信息：最优盆地宽度、不稳定性边界位置、参数交互（不可分离）结构等。已有的损失景观分析（权重空间）表明几何结构深刻影响泛化，而超参数空间中的对应研究长期缺失。已有的超参数重要性研究（Probst 等对 40 个学习器的分析、Van Rijn & Hutter 的函数 ANOVA）都是基于稀疏采样而非枚举，且未使用形式化景观指标；OpenML/YAHPO 提供的是代理近似而非真值枚举；大规模调参项目也未产出可用于景观级分析的细粒度真值数据。根本原因是穷举评估的计算开销。以往的落地障碍并非认知层面，而是工程与基础设施层面：缺少可扩展、可复现、容错的穷举网格评估系统。

Method: 系统（ExaTune）：五阶段流水线——(I) Pydantic 校验的 YAML 配置展开为笛卡尔网格 Λ_G=∏Λ_k（支持线性/对数刻度，对数网格按 points-per-decade 生成），每个配置以排序键值对的 128 位 MD5 摘要做无冲突查找；(II) Jinja2 模板为每个网格点渲染一个 SBATCH 脚本，作为 SLURM job array 提交，作业 i 的随机种子设为 s₀+i，并设并发上限以避免耗尽配额；(III) 每个 worker 独立做 K 折交叉验证，得到 f̂(λ)=mean_j M(h_{λ,D\D_j},D_j)、方差 σ̂²、逐折分数与计时，失败时写结构化错误记录以保持全网格完整性；(IV) 逐作业 JSON（result_{i:06d}.json）合并为单个 Apache Parquet（Snappy 压缩，支持谓词下推），另附 CSV；(V) 计算景观指标并可视化。

景观形式化：在超参数网格图 G=(Λ_G,E) 上定义邻接（恰一维相差一个秩位），最大度 2d，直径 Σ(m_k−1)。指标包括：(1) Moran ℐ（对称邻接矩阵 W，S₀=Σw_ij，期望值 −1/(n−1)；ℐ→1 平滑可局部/BO 搜索，ℐ≪期望为棋盘状需穷举）；(2) 崎岖度 R=min(1, n⁻¹ΣVar_{Ñ(λ)}(f̂)/Var(f̂))，与 ℐ 互补（ℐ 刻画依赖方向、R 刻画幅度），另附梯度统计与粗糙系数 ϱ=σ({g_e})/(f̂max−f̂min)；(3) 局部最优集合 O（严格局部极大）、最优密度 δ_O=|O|/n、漏斗指数 φ_ε=（距全局最优 ≤ε(f̂max−f̂min) 的网格点比例，默认 ε=0.05），另含 BFS 深度 ℓ 的滞后自相关相关图 I_ℓ；(4) FDC=Pearson(−f̂(λ), d_G(λ,λ*))，其中 d_G 为秩空间曼哈顿距离，>0.15 为"大谷"结构、<−0.15 为欺骗性景观；(5) 方差分解：η²_k=SS_B^(k)/SS_T（单因素 ANOVA 效应量，Ση²_k≤1 当且仅当加性独立），配合 Spearman 相关与归一化极差构成复合排名；交互强度 Ω_{k1,k2}=max(0, η²_{k1,k2}−η²_{k1}−η²_{k2})>0 说明两参数不可独立调参，复杂度 O(d²n)。

基准与实验：5 个模型族（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、岭回归、KNN），每族取实践中最高频的 d∈{2,…,7} 个超参，网格分辨率约束 |Λ_G|≤1.2×10⁵ 以保证可穷举；8 个数据集（MNIST、UCI Adult、妊娠糖尿病、孕妇风险、Titanic、Wine、Diabetes、California Housing），5 折 CV，分类用加权 F1、回归用负 MSE；在 DRAC Fir 集群（2×AMD EPYC 9655，192 核/节点）上以每配置一个 SLURM 任务、2–4 CPU/任务执行。对比实验将 Random Search、Bayesian Optimization、Hyperband、Optuna(TPE) 在固定 100 次试验预算下与 ExaTune 全网格比较，统计覆盖率、与全局最优的平均绝对差、能耗与 CO₂（CodeCarbon），并做缩放分析（以 20 次 bootstrap 估计不同网格比例下的 node-hours）。

Result: 景观表（表 2，8 张景观共 285,080 配置）：SVM/MNIST（d=2，1,000 点）最平滑，ℐ=0.966、R=0.035、FDC=0.621；KNN/Wine 最崎岖，R=0.458、ℐ=0.692，且 δ_O=0.353、φ=0.020（局部最优最多、峰最窄）；回归景观漏斗最宽（φ≥0.54）、局部最优最少（δ_O≤0.007），Ridge/Diabetes 的 FDC≈0.019 说明性能与配置距离近乎无关；XGBoost 拓扑多样，GD 与 Titanic 的 FDC 近零或微负（欺骗性），RF/Adult FDC=0.398（大谷）；最极端的是 XGBoost/GD，φ<0.001——全局最优几乎只占单一网格点，标准预算下的近似方法几乎不可能命中。缩放：运行时间从 GD 的 23 分钟到 Titanic 的 55 小时 50 分（112,320 点，XGBoost），说明 |Λ_G|≤10⁵ 在标准学术 HPC 配额内可行；d≥8 时 |Λ_G|>10⁶，建议自适应网格细化。

HPO 对比（表 3/7）：100 次试验下所有近似方法覆盖率仅 0.09%（Titanic）至 2.06%（GD/Maternal Risk），98%–100% 景观区域从未被观测；与全局最优的平均绝对差极小（Hyperband/Optuna 0.0011，随机搜索 0.0022），且在 Diabetes、Wine 上近似方法已追平全局最优——说明"近似最优 ≠ 刻画了景观"，近似方法按设计丢弃低性能区域，因而无法察觉不稳定悬崖、次级最优与交互结构；未观测部分并非拓扑中性（低梯度区、宽盆地恰被系统性欠采样）。代价：4 个有完整能耗记录的数据集上 ExaTune 用 3.75 kWh、排放 558.8 g CO₂，而近似方法单次运行 <0.003 kWh、<0.2 g CO₂，差距约 1000–17,000×；完整 8 景观集合约 1–2 kg CO₂，量级可比一次中等规模 GPU 训练。作者还给出按 max_depth×learning_rate 的逐配置碳排放景观（Titanic-XGBoost），显示排放随超参非单调变化呈高度崎岖，随机搜索与 BO 采样点同样落在高排放区。

可复现性/一致性问题：附录 D 的 GD/Maternal Risk 网格规格（12×13×30，subsample 等固定）乘积为 4,680，与表中"观测到的" 4,862 不符；表 2 中 SVM/MNIST 与 GD 的部分 FDC/φ 未计算（"—"）；SVM/MNIST 的近似方法对比与 UCI Adult、Housing、Maternal Risk 的 ExaTune 能耗/CO₂ 记录为 N/A（"forthcoming"）；Diabetes 数据集实为 Pima Diabetes，其二值目标被当作连续响应回归（以 R² 缩放的负 MSE 计分），任务定义与分类基线存在混淆。方法论上，覆盖率完全由预算/网格规模之比决定，其"近似方法必然漏掉结构"的论证几乎是解析结论而非经验发现，且未报告多种子重复与显著性检验，"发现不稳定区/次级最优/交互"多以图 1 的定性示例呈现。

Conclusion: ExaTune 的价值在于把"完整景观图"确立为一类一等科学制品：它将隐式的几何结构转为可量化、可审计的公共基准，可用于审计 HPO 驱动的基准比较可靠性（窄脊上的配置与宽盆地内的配置即使验证分数相同，可靠性却截然不同），并揭示优化器行为在何时是数据集特异的。由于景观集合永久公开、碳成本可被所有下游使用摊销，作者建议仅在"可复用真值景观本身即科学目标"时采用穷举，生产环境选型仍应以标准 HPO 为默认。局限：穷举仅在 d≲6 的低维超参空间与经典 tabular ML 上可行，不适用于深度学习/神经架构搜索；景观条件于固定的"数据集–模型–预处理"组合，跨划分或特征编码可能改变拓扑；连续超参被离散化带来子网格插值误差；d 维性能张量无法在三维以上可视化，只能靠二维切片或边缘投影，易掩盖未显示参数间的高阶交互（需面向景观拓扑的降维方法）。未来方向包括自适应网格细化、多保真景观近似、以及向 NAS 的扩展。作者声明代码由 Claude Code 协作实现（测试、调试），所有科学决策、实验设计、网格定义与结果解释由人类研究者作出；代码开源于 github.com/Dick-AI-Lab/ExaTune，景观集合托管于 HuggingFace（Dick-AI-Lab/ExaTune_landscapes，含 Croissant 元数据）并欢迎社区按提交协议补充新景观。

Abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) returns a single optimal configuration, systematically discarding the explored performance landscape that encodes how results depend on configuration choices. Fitness landscape analysis comprises a robust collection of methods from evolutionary computation offering ruggedness indices, autocorrelation functions, and fitness-distance correlation that have never been applied to machine learning hyperparameter spaces at scale, given that fine-grained ground-truth enumeration data has not existed. We present ExaTune, an open-source HPC system to produce a new artifact class: the hyperparameter landscape map. ExaTune exhaustively evaluates every point on a discretized hyperparameter grid via $K$-fold cross-validation, aggregates results into reproducible parquet benchmarks, and applies a suite of five formalized landscape metrics: spatial autocorrelation (Moran's $I$), ruggedness, local optima density, fitness-distance correlation (FDC), and variance-based parameter importance. We release a benchmark collection of 8 complete landscape maps (totalling 285,080 exhaustively evaluated configurations) spanning five model families (SVMs, random forests, XGBoost, ridge regression, and $k$-nearest neighbors) across six classification and two regression benchmarks, hosted on HuggingFace. Empirical analysis demonstrates that Bayesian optimization, Optuna, Hyperband, and Random Search at standard trial budgets systematically miss instability regions, secondary optima, and parameter interaction effects that are visible in complete landscapes; information that is structurally unavailable to any optimizer by design.

</details>


### [352] [Embedding Semantic Entropy: NLI-Free Semantic Uncertainty Estimation with Geometry-Aware Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03876)
*Akshiya Raveendran,Praveenasarma Baskarakurukkal,Pragatheeswaran Vipulanandan,Kamal Premaratne,Uthayasanker Thayasivam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出「Embedding Semantic Entropy（Emb-SE）」：把语义熵（SE）中基于 DeBERTa 双向蕴含（entailment）的硬聚类，替换为在句向量嵌入空间中的 K-Medoids 聚类，并用「Davies–Bouldin 指数 + medoid 紧致度约束 + 肘部准则」动态选择簇数 K*，最后在簇级概率分布上计算熵作为不确定性分数。在 5 个短答案 QA 数据集 × 4 个开源 7B 模型（20 个设置）上，Emb-SE 的 AUROC 在 15 个设置中取得最优或并列最优，AUARC 在 13 个设置中最优或并列最优；对 SE 的成对胜率为 0.80（AUROC）/0.70（AUARC），对 DSE/KLE/PE/P(True)/ER 均有优势，且完全免除了 NLI 推理开销，同时提供可检视的簇几何（medoid、簇内紧致度、簇间分离度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 常生成流畅但错误的答案（幻觉），可靠部署需要不确定性估计。经典语义熵 SE（Farquhar et al., 2024）通过双向蕴含模型对采样回答做「语义等价」硬聚类，再对语义簇的似然质量分布求熵。其局限在于：(1) 依赖外部 NLI 组件（DeBERTa），需 O(n^2) 次成对蕴含推理，计算冗余；(2) 蕴含判定是黑箱离散标签，无法体现簇内紧致度与簇间分离度等几何性质，难以解释「为什么这些回答被归为一组」；(3) 已有替代方案（KLE 的核相似度矩阵、Semantic Density 的嵌入分布）虽更连续，却不显式产生语义簇结构，缺失簇级可解释性与聚类质量校验。论文据此主张：把「语义分组」重述为一个白盒、可检视的嵌入空间聚类问题，在不损失（或甚至提升）不确定估计性能的前提下替代 NLI 蕴含聚类。

Method: 流程（仅替换 SE 的聚类阶段，其余熵计算沿用 SE 范式）：
1) 输入准备：对问题 q 采样 n=10 个回答 a_i；将答案与问题拼接为「Context: q \n Answer: a_i」后再嵌入（避免「London」这类脱离上下文的歧义）；做小写化、去冠词、Unicode 归一化、噪声清洗。
2) 嵌入表示：用监督版 SimCSE（princeton-nlp/sup-simcse-roberta-large）编码得到 e_i，并做 L2 归一化 ė_i（此时 ||ê_i−ê_j||² = 2−2cos，故欧氏距离等价于余弦相似度）。
3) 退化处理：n=1 或所有归一化嵌入近乎相同（max_i||ê_i−ê_1||₂ < ε_id=1e-8）时，全部归入单一簇（语义分歧为零）。
4) 聚类：对每个候选 K∈{2,…,min(10,n)} 用 K-Medoids（cluster-medoids，PAM 优化，k-medoids++ 初始化，欧氏距离，固定随机种子）聚类；排除全单例的退化 K。选 K-Medoids 而非 K-Means 是因为 medoid 是真实生成的答案，可直接作为该语义组的代表回答。
5) 动态簇数选择（三级）：(a) 显式紧致度约束——对每簇计算到 medoid 的平均距离 D_C，若 max_C D_C > τ 则剔除该 K，阻止把不同含义合并进松散大簇（会低估熵）；(b) Davies–Bouldin 指数 DB=(1/K)Σ_i max_{j≠i}(S_i+S_j)/M_ij 同时度量簇内离散度与簇间分离度，DB 越小越好；(c) 肘部准则——对 K≥3 计算改进比 r=|Δ₂|/(|Δ₁|+ε)（Δ₁=DB_{K-2}−DB_{K-1}, Δ₂=DB_{K-1}−DB_K），若 r<γ 则判定肘点并取 K*=K−1（避免过度切分改写导致高估熵）；若无明显肘点，则在通过紧致度约束的候选中取 DB 最小者作为回退。K=1 时 DB/肘部无意义；K=2 时无法形成三连 DB 序列故不计算 r。
6) 不确定性计算：逐 token 条件概率求和得序列对数似然 ℓ_i，用 softmax 归一化为 P_{S_i}；按最终簇归属聚合为 P_{C_k}=Σ_{i∈C_k} P_{S_i}（保证 Σ_k P_{C_k}=1）；最终 H_EmbSE(q) = −Σ_k P_{C_k} log P_{C_k}。低熵表示质量集中于单一语义簇，高熵表示质量分散于多个分离簇。
7) 超参：对每个「模型–数据集」设置用 5 折交叉验证网格搜索 τ∈[0.10,0.50]（步长 0.05）与 γ∈[0.01,0.50]（步长 0.01），以验证 AUROC 选最优；τ 主要按模型分组（响应离散度差异），γ 主要按数据集分组（语义簇分离清晰度）。
实验设置：TriviaQA、SQuAD、NQ-Open、SVAMP、BioASQ；Falcon-7B-Instruct、LLaMA-2-7B、LLaMA-2-7B-Chat、Gemma-7B；每题 T=1.0、top-K=50 采样 10 个回答用于不确定性估计，另采 1 个 T=0.1 回答用于准确率判定；5-shot、上下文按数据集可选、最长 50 新 token。对比基线：SE、DSE、ER、KLE(K_HEAT)、PE、P(True)。指标：AUROC 与 AUARC（accuracy-rejection curve）。

Result: 20 个「模型×数据集」设置上，Emb-SE 在 15 个设置取得最佳或并列最佳 AUROC、13 个设置取得最佳或并列最佳 AUARC。成对胜率（平局计 0.5）：AUROC 对 SE 0.80、DSE 0.72、KLE 0.90、PE 0.90、P(True) 1.00、ER 1.00；AUARC 对 SE 0.70、DSE 0.95、KLE 0.90、PE 0.80、P(True) 1.00、ER 0.95。逐模型看：Gemma-7B 上 Emb-SE 全部 5 个数据集 AUARC 最佳/并列最佳、4 个数据集 AUROC 最佳；Falcon-7B-Instruct 在 TriviaQA/SQuAD/NQ/BioASQ 的 AUROC 最高（SVAMP 由 PE 最优）；LLaMA-2-7B 在 TriviaQA/NQ/BioASQ 最优（SQuAD 由 DSE、SVAMP 由 SE 领先）；LLaMA-2-7B-Chat 在 TriviaQA/SQuAD/NQ/BioASQ 最佳或并列，但 SVAMP 明显偏弱。数值示例：Falcon TriviaQA AUROC 0.796/AUARC 0.549（SE 0.791/0.549），Gemma NQ AUROC 0.767（SE 0.744）、SVAMP 0.378（SE 0.364）。整体平均 ΔAUROC 亦为正（对 SE 平均 +0.025）。超参选择显示 Falcon-7B-Instruct 倾向更严的紧致度（τ≈0.11），LLaMA-2-7B-Chat 更松（τ≈0.23），γ 随数据集差异明显（NQ 0.39 → BioASQ 0.21）。论文明确承认：Emb-SE 并非在所有基准上全面占优，在部分 SQuAD/SVAMP 设置下蕴含类或概率类基线仍更强。

Conclusion: 结论：几何感知的嵌入空间聚类可在几乎无性能损失（多数设置甚至更优）的情况下替代 DeBERTa 蕴含聚类，说明强外部 NLI 分类器并非语义不确定性估计的必要条件；K-Medoids 提供的 medoid、簇内紧致度与簇间分离度使「哪些语义组存在、代表回答是谁、组有多紧」可直接检视，把黑箱蕴含判定转化为透明的白盒聚类问题，同时节省成对 NLI 推理开销（代价是引入嵌入模型与聚类开销）。局限：仍需访问 token/序列概率（仅返回文本的完全黑盒 API 不适用）；每题需对多候选 K 重复聚类，计算量上升；未专门报告簇质量与下游误差的定量关联，也未与 KLE 等连续方法做同预算消融。未来方向包括更强的嵌入模型、面向黑盒 API 的无似然变体、跨长回答/多跳 QA 的扩展，以及把簇几何本身作为可解释性信号直接输出。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate fluent yet incorrect responses, making un- certainty estimation important for reliable deployment. Semantic Entropy (SE) estimates uncertainty by clustering responses based on semantic equivalence, but it relies on hard entailment-based clustering. We propose Embedding Semantic Entropy, which replaces entailment-based clustering with K-Medoids in semantic embedding space and uses dynamic cluster selection to account for intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. We evaluate the method on TriviaQA, SQuAD, NQ-Open, SVAMP, and BioASQ using Falcon- 7B-Instruct, LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-7B-Chat, and Gemma-7B. Results show competitive AUROC and AUARC performance, suggesting that NLI-based entailment clustering can be replaced with embedding-space clustering with limited degradation while improving the inspectability of semantic grouping. This matters because semantic uncertainty scores depend on underlying semantic groups; by making these groups explicit, compact, and separable in embedding space, Emb-SE turns uncertainty estimation from a black-box en- tailment decision into an inspectable clustering problem.

</details>


### [353] [The Information Limits of Neural Controlled Differential Equations Under Sparse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03887)
*Rostislav Gusev,Evgenia Romanenkova,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏观测下 Neural CDE 的"信息极限"：当平面驱动路径仅在离散时刻被采样时，区间内的连续路径几何（尤以有向面积为主）无法确定，却会通过 Lie 括号影响终端隐状态与预测。作者给出终端状态识别集（identified set）的带状体（zonotope）主阶刻画、面向标量目标的可计算模糊性证书 R₂(S)，并证明确定性自适应采样下的 minimax 剩余半径在仅有速度界时为 Θ(N⁻¹)、同时约束加速度时为 Θ(N⁻²)；对"面积型 CDE"给出精确值 L²T²/(2πN)，且均匀网格即最优。实验表明证书直径与可行圆弧补全的输出展宽高度一致（Spearman 0.9987，中位比 0.981），且证书引导的选点策略接近一步前瞻 oracle。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Neural CDE 通过插值把离散观测转成连续控制路径，但插值只固定了端点增量，未确定区间内的路径几何（尤其是平面驱动上的有向面积）。当向量场不对易时，这些未观测几何会经由 Lie 括号影响隐状态并沿后续动力学传播，导致同一观测记录对应一族不同的终端响应。因此需要量化：(i) 固定观测下终端响应的部分识别（partial identification）结构；(ii) 一个面向具体预测目标、可计算的"模糊性证书"，用于评估采样方案的充分性并指导在哪里补充观测；(iii) 在最优（自适应）采样策略下，剩余不确定性还能被压到多小的信息极限。此前工作（Kidger et al. 2020；Morrill et al. 2022；Bleistein & Guilloux 2024；Walker et al. 2024）关注插值方案、高阶签名与采样依赖的泛化界，但未把"缺失路径几何"与"终端输出的可辨识性/信息半径"联系起来。

Method: 问题形式化：设 d=2 平面驱动 X: W^{k,∞}，观测记录 S={(t_i,x_i)}；定义与观测一致的可容许路径类 𝒳_L(S)（速度上界 L）与 𝒳_{L,M}(S)（再加加速度上界 M），终端状态识别集 𝒵_T(S;𝒞) 与标量响应识别集 𝒴_T(S;𝒞)；定义确定性自适应策略的信息半径 ℜ_N = inf_π sup_X rad(F(ℱ_π(X;𝒞)))。主要工具与结果：(1) Dido 等周长问题——固定端点、固定弧长下可达有向面积恰为区间 [−A_⋆(r,ℓ), A_⋆(r,ℓ)]，A_⋆(r,ℓ)=ℓ²(θ−sinθ)/(2θ²)，r/ℓ=2sin(θ/2)/θ，且 A_⋆≤ℓ²/(2π)（r=2ℓ/π 取等）；在 W^{1,∞} 下各区间的面积可独立选取（Corollary A.3）。(2) 局部展开：Φ_X(z̄_i)−Φ_X̄(z̄_i)=a_i(X)[V₁,V₂](z̄_i)+O(L³Δt³)，经线性传输 P_i=J_{n−1}⋯J_{i+1} 得 b_i=P_i[V₁,V₂](z̄_i)，K(S)={Σa_i b_i: |a_i|≤A_i^⋆}，Theorem 4.1 给出 d_H(𝒵_T, z̄_T+K(S)) ≤ C_Z(S₃+S₂²)，误差 O(δ²)，常数与采样数/位置无关。(3) 标量证书：c_i=∇g(z̄_T)ᵀb_i，R₂(S)=Σ A_i^⋆|c_i|，Theorem 4.2 给出 𝒴_T 与 [F(X̄)±R₂] 的 Hausdorff 界及 |diam𝒴_T−2R₂|≤2C_Y(S₃+S₂²)；c_i 可由伴随（adjoint）反向递推 λ_i=J_iᵀλ_{i+1}、λ_n=∇g(z̄_T) 无需求显式 P_i 获得。(4) Minimax：Theorem 5.1（速度界）限下界 A_⋆(v,L)(∫_I√β_{v,u})²，均匀采样给出 O(N⁻¹) 上界，故 ℜ_N=Θ(N⁻¹)；Theorem 5.2（速度+加速度）需用三阶对称变分抵消二次余项，并构造夹持（clamped）扰动 η_i 得 |a_i|=vMΔt³/32，限下界 vM/32(∫_I β^{1/3})³，得 ℜ_N=Θ(N⁻²)；Proposition 5.3 对"面积 CDE"给出精确 ℜ_N = L²T²/(2πN)，且均匀非自适应网格达到，适应性无收益。实验：训练平面 Neural CDE（隐藏维 14，tanh MLP 宽 40，Heun 积分），用圆弧补全构造两个可行路径检验证书精度，用全局 C¹ 常加速度分段搜索检验正则性影响，用证书引导的中点选点策略（含一步前瞻 oracle）做采集实验。

Result: 几何层面：平面速度有界下每个观测间隙的有向面积可达区间由 Dido 定理精确给出，且各区间面积可独立实现；终端状态识别集被 ẑ_T+K(S) 以 O(δ²) 的 Hausdorff 误差逼近（常数对任意采样数/位置一致）。证书层面：R₂(S)=Σ A_i^⋆|c_i| 是目标特异的半宽，|diam𝒴_T−2R₂|≤2C_Y(S₃+S₂²)；若某间隙 c_i=0 则该间隙在主阶不贡献模糊性，c_i 全零时只剩 O(δ²) 余项（不保证精确可辨识）。信息极限：非退化平面 CDE（存在非零传输 Lie 括号敏感度区间 I）下，ℜ_N=Θ(N⁻¹)（仅速度界）、Θ(N⁻²)（速度+加速度界），常数依赖 A_⋆(v,L) 与目标敏感度 β；面积 CDE 有精确有限预算解 L²T²/(2πN)，均匀网格 minimax 最优。实验：96 个路径相关目标评估中证书直径与圆弧对输出展宽的 Spearman 相关 0.9987，中位比 0.981，观测数 5→33 时中位相对偏差 5.49%→1.69%；展宽随最大间隙的 log–log 斜率 1.01，绝对偏差斜率 1.55；端点型负对照的证书直径仅为路径相关目标的 0.07%；加速度感知外逼近宽度中位为速度界证书的 7.11%，斜率 1.04 vs 2.26，其与全局 C¹ 搜索展宽相关 0.975 但量级仅为 9.11%（保守性来源未分离）；采集实验中最大局部模糊度与中点缩减规则的归一化 AUC 均为 3.633，接近一步 oracle 的 3.626，明显优于最长间隙 3.823 与随机 4.544。附录还给出加速感知外证书（Prop. G.1）、单点新增观测后的条件面积纤维（Lemma G.2）、中点选点的闭式评分（G.4）、以及交换性作为结构性对照（可交换常向量场的输出展宽约 8.55e-16，非交换系统约 4.28e-4）。

Conclusion: 本文把"稀疏观测下 Neural CDE 的部分可辨识性"系统化为一个几何—信息论框架：对平面驱动，未观测路径的主阶不确定性是各观测间隙的可行有向面积，其影响方向由传输后的 Lie 括号决定，因而终端状态识别集可用带状体刻画，并可投影为面向具体预测目标的可计算证书 R₂(S)（伴随法高效求值）；该证书可直接用于评估采样方案、定位信息量不足的间隙并指导补充观测（实验中其选点性能已接近一步前瞻 oracle）。在信息极限方面，剩余不确定性的 minimax 半径在速度约束下为 Θ(N⁻¹)、加速度约束下为 Θ(N⁻²)，并在面积型 CDE 上给出精确等式，说明自适应选点在最坏情形下并不优于均匀网格。局限：几何刻画仅适用于平面驱动（更高维需处理耦合的面积分量及其联合可行性）；加速感知证书因各间隙面积不能独立选取（速度需在观测点相容）以及余项量级为 δ² 而偏保守，其实证仅是受限搜索族下的外逼近；正则性假设必须能覆盖真实信号，否则识别保证失效；结论限定于确定性自适应策略、合成平面数据与固定（冻结）学习到的动力学，物理传感场景与最优自适应信息半径的差距仍待研究。

Abstract: Neural controlled differential equations (Neural CDEs) evolve hidden states along continuous paths constructed by interpolating discrete observations. Sparse measurements leave the input between observation times undetermined, and admissible continuous paths consistent with the same data can produce different terminal states. We characterize this ambiguity for planar drivers with bounded speed. The set of compatible terminal states admits a leading-order zonotopic approximation determined by feasible signed areas and transported Lie brackets. Its projection onto a scalar prediction yields a computable, target-specific ambiguity certificate. We also study the number of measurements needed to reduce the remaining uncertainty. For nondegenerate planar CDEs, the optimal worst-case radius over deterministic adaptive sampling policies scales as $N^{-1}$ when speed is bounded and $N^{-2}$ when both speed and acceleration are bounded, where $N$ is the number of observation intervals. Synthetic experiments assess the certificate using admissible continuous completions and examine the role of path regularity.

</details>


### [354] [When Latent Dynamics Meet Data Assimilation: A Benchmark of Koopman-Type Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03916)
*Zhiwei Zhang,Wenxuan Yuan,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Pouria Behnoudfar,Chuanqi Chen,Charlotte Moser,Yuta Tarumi,Jin-Long Wu,Rossella Arcucci,Takemasa Miyoshi,Nan Chen,Marc Bocquet,Sibo Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统对比了七种 Koopman 型隐式数据同化方法（DMD、NL-AE、WL-AE、KAE、Tensor-Var、DBF、CGKN）在五个系统（Lorenz-96、圆柱绕流、浅水、ERA5 两种分辨率）上的表现，涵盖预报/同化精度、物理状态恢复、隐空间轨迹行为、动力学一致性，以及高斯性、凸性、解唯一性等可解性诊断。核心结论：Koopman 结构带来的线性化收益并非自动转化为更好的同化效果，存在"表示灵活性—优化可解性"的权衡；线性隐转移可稳定短期预报但在强混沌/高维系统表达力受限，具有闭式分析更新的方法整体更稳健，但矩阵求逆仍是计算瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman 算子理论把非线性动力系统提升到可观测函数空间后线性演化，因此 Koopman 表示天然适合数据同化（DA）：线性隐转移配合线性观测耦合与高斯误差假设，可使预报分布解析传播、使分析更新闭式求解、或使变分目标成为凸二次问题。已有工作（DMDEnKF、KAE-EnKF、Neural Koopman Prior、Tensor-Var 等）都试图利用这一点，但它们在隐表示、观测耦合方式、同化流程（变分 vs 滤波）上差异混杂，难以分离各结构因素的作用。同时，LDA 并不保证隐空间保留 DA 所需的统计性质：非线性隐网络（尤其是 Transformer 类）传播若干步后会产生非高斯预报分布与非凸同化目标。因此需要回答的核心问题是：不同 Koopman 型 LDA 结构各自贡献了什么，在什么条件下有益？

Method: 构建统一评测框架，在共用编码器-解码器架构下逐级加强隐转移约束，得到三个自编码器变体：NL-AE（非线性隐转移基线）、WL-AE（非线性转移 + 隐空间一致性损失 + 时间拉直正则 + 谱半径惩罚）、KAE（显式线性 Koopman 转移，z_{t+1}=Kz_t）。在此基础上纳入四个代表性 Koopman 型同化方法：DMD（快照奇异值分解低秩线性表示 + 观测导出隐目标）、Tensor-Var（线性 Koopman 转移 + 基于条件均值嵌入/RKHS 的逆观测编码器 E_y，观测项在隐空间线性化，目标为凸二次且有块三对角闭式解）、DBF（线性高斯转移 + 高斯逆观测算子，闭式递归高斯滤波更新）、CGKN（观测依赖的条件仿射 Koopman 算子 K_{t+1} 与观測-隐状态耦合动力学，条件高斯滤波）。评测维度分三层：①预报/同化精度（RRMSE、SSIM、NMB 方差比、观测比 5–50%、同化间隔）；②物理场与功率谱（PSD）结构恢复、隐轨迹 t-SNE 与归一化分析-参考距离；③动力学一致性与可解性（ResDMD 残差比、Henze-Zirkler 联合高斯性检验与 Mardia 偏度/峰度、Gauss-Newton Hessian 最小特征值与特征谱、闭式 vs 迭代的计算耗时）。五个基准：Lorenz-96(D=40, F=8)、CFDBench 圆柱绕流(64×64)、PDEArena 浅水(96×192)、ERA5-Coarse(5.625°)与 ERA5-High(1.5°)。误差协方差用 NMC 方法估计背景误差协方差并做迹正则化；高斯性实验采用 512 个高斯扰动背景样本并投影到 B 的前 25 维主特征子空间。神经网络模型用 3 个随机种子训练，同化用线性采样掩码观测算子、无测量噪声（表征误差计入观测误差协方差）。

Result: 1) 预报：Koopman 类（KAE/Tensor-Var）在短期与近周期系统上更准，但长时程上非线性转移模型（NL-AE/WL-AE）在若干数据集反超；自编码器变体中约束越强短期预报通常越好。2) 同化：每次分析更新一般降低当前误差，但改善常不能在后续预报传播中保持；线性闭式方法（Tensor-Var/DBF/CGKN）误差演化更可控，且随观测比提高普遍受益，而 KAE 在 ERA5-High 上随观测比升高反而变差（表示误差+解码器耦合）。3) 偏差诊断：各方法 NMB 接近 0；DMD 在 Lorenz-96 出现严重方差坍缩（VR=0.299），KAE 在 ERA5-High 方差不足（VR=0.813），Tensor-Var/DBF/CGKN 能更好保持真实方差。4) 频谱：分析普遍能恢复低波数大尺度结构，高波数细尺度恢复困难（解码器平滑+部分观测抑制），观测比提高无法彻底解决；KAE 在中高波数恢复最弱，DBF 明显低估高波数能量，CGKN 随观测比改善。5) 隐轨迹：Tensor-Var 与 DMD 的分析轨迹最贴近编码参考轨迹（Tensor-Var 全面优于 DMD），CGKN/DBF 的分析轨迹与参考差异大，因其训练目标不直接约束分析均值与编码参考对齐。6) 动力学一致性：同化通常降低与 Koopman 演化的一致性（ResDMD 残差比 >1），KAE 在 ERA5-High 尤其明显；CGKN 残差比在所有系统 <1，DBF 接近 1。7) 高斯性：迭代式变分（NL-AE/WL-AE）产生明显偏斜与厚尾，KAE 稍好；闭式方法（线性转移+线性观测使解为高斯误差的仿射函数）高斯性保持最好，CGKN 最佳。8) 凸性：解码器耦合的观测项是主导非凸来源（观测项负曲率大于模型项），KAE 虽消去模型项负曲率但整体仍非凸；DMD/Tensor-Var 严格凸二次且解唯一，但强约束并不等于高精度（DMD 在 Cylinder 上正特征值比例更高却更不准）。9) 耗时：自编码器变体迭代优化最贵；DMD/Tensor-Var 用块三对角闭式解显著省算力但受矩阵求逆/构造隐目标开销制约；DBF 同化开销最低，CGKN 次之。10) 同化间隔：Lorenz-96 上观测间隔远短于误差倍增时间时固定线性转移有效，间隔变长后非线性模型（NL-AE/WL-AE）与 Tensor-Var 优势反转/消失，CGKN 对间隔与观测充足性最敏感。11) 观测历史：延迟坐标嵌入视角下历史观测对 Lorenz-96 改善显著，稀疏观测时补充信息价值更大。

Conclusion: Koopman 表示只有与恰当的观测耦合和同化流程结合才能真正提升 LDA 的可解性：线性隐转移本身既不保证目标凸性，也不保证高斯误差假设成立。更强地线性化会把非线性负担从隐转移转移到解码器观测耦合上，观测项成为主导非凸来源；即使隐目标凸且有唯一解，也不保证物理状态重建准确（DMD vs Tensor-Var 即为反例）。实现高斯假设或唯一解必须配合能保留物理信息的灵活隐表示与足够有效的观测约束。反过来，分析修正可提升当前状态精度却破坏与 Koopman 动力学/隐空间线性演化的一致性，这解释了为何当前分析的改善无法持续到后续预报传播中。谱半径≤1 的 Koopman 矩阵无增长模态，混沌系统的误差增长无法在隐动力学中表示，只能以相对于编码轨迹的残差形式出现——这统一解释了同化间隔实验与 ResDMD 残差两组现象。作者指出局限：除受控自编码器对比外，隐表示/观测耦合/训练目标的差异限制了归因；非线性变分目标的 Hessian 分析仅反映局部曲率而非全局凸性；高斯性诊断受有限样本量影响。未来方向：把分析修正纳入训练、将动力学一致性写入同化目标，在保持灵活性的同时联合设计隐表示、隐转移、观测耦合与同化流程，并在更广的观测间隔、噪声水平与非高斯不确定性下评估；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Koopman representations describe nonlinear dynamics through linear evolution in a transformed space, offering an attractive framework for their linear simplicity and generality. Yet these advantages do not necessarily translate into improved performance in deep latent data assimilation (LDA). We systematically compare seven representative methods and structural baselines across five systems spanning approximately periodic to strongly chaotic dynamics and a broad range of state dimensions. We evaluate forecast and assimilation accuracy, physical state recovery, latent-trajectory behavior, and dynamical consistency, and assess Gaussian error assumptions, objective convexity, and uniqueness of analysis solutions. Our results reveal a trade-off between representational flexibility and optimization tractability. Linear evolution of the latent state can stabilize short-term forecasts but restrict expressiveness in strongly chaotic and high-dimensional systems, without consistently improving assimilation accuracy. Parameterized linear operators offer greater flexibility, yet their joint optimization with the encoder--decoder remains nonconvex. Methods with closed-form analysis updates generally perform better and exhibit greater robustness in our experiments, although matrix inversion remains a computational bottleneck. These findings show that the practical benefits of Koopman structure depend on both sufficient observational information and the choice of assimilation procedure.

</details>


### [355] [Sequential auditing of connected forecast errors under partial observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03928)
*Yuanbo Zhou,Junjie Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"图预测区间违约的序贯审计"问题：审计者在标签仅部分可见时，可选择性地查询缺失标签，以判断图中是否存在至少 k 个节点连成一组、且其实际结果同侧违反各自预测区间（如全部低于下界或全部高于上界）。作者给出精确停止条件（证书存在性判定），并对 MOMS、最短见证、最短池、JW、筛选随机等策略在三个公开图时间序列上做比较。结论是：MOMS 相对筛选随机减少 19.6%–38.5% 的查询数，但这一优势并不稳健地优于其他利用见证结构的规则；减少查询并不必然带来更早的事件发现或更低的本地计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图/交通信号预测系统普遍使用预测区间来量化不确定性，但审计者往往只能获得部分真实观测值。要核查"某区域是否出现系统性预测误差"，必须决定先取回哪些标签。核心问题是：能否在收齐所有缺失标签之前就做出判定？已有的图异常检测（扫描统计、连通区域）、交互式子图检测与主动学习工作关注的是识别异常区域或训练检测器，而非"为判定一个明确定义的连通违约事件而选择观测对象"。同时，查询数、事件早期发现率与计算开销这三个评价准则可能偏好不同策略，需要在同一形式化框架下加以澄清。

Method: 形式化：在无向图 G=(V,E) 上，节点 i 有真实值 y_i、预测区间 [L_i,U_i]，标签 z_i∈{-1,0,+1}（分别低于下界、区间内、高于上界）；事件 F_k(z) 为存在一个 k 节点的连通子集其标签全为同号 s（正/负见证）。审计者以单位代价查询隐藏标签；检索到的标签假定精确，图与区间在审计期间不变。作者证明精确停止规则：若存在未完成见证且无完整见证，则"全赋同号"给出正完成、"全赋 0"给出负完成，两者均与观测一致，故无法判定；全部见证被否定则事件不存在，全部见证完成则事件存在。实现上提出等价的连通分量遍历判据：已知同号节点的连通块≥k 即可证明存在；否则若"同号∪未知"的兼容子图无规模≥k 的连通块，则事件不存在；兼容块中的每个未知节点都隶属于某个可能见证，因此无需枚举所有连通子集。邻接用 Python 整数位集存储。策略包括：MOMS（按最小残余集出现次数打分 S_i=Σ1{|R|=d, i∈R}）、JW 适配（对含 i 的带符号残余集求和 2^{-|R|}）、最短见证（取未知数最少的见证，优先查询其中度数最高节点）、最短池（候选限于最小残余集再计频次）、原始计数、筛选随机（按固定 ID/度数/随机序跳过不在任何存活见证中的节点）；并给出打包（packed）MOMS 实现（编码排序索引与符号为无符号整数、检查溢出、去重），与参考实现做等价性校验。实验：METR-LA、WikiMaths64（seed 2026 选 64 节点）、MontevideoBus；岭回归预测器（4 阶自身滞后+4 阶邻域聚合滞后+截距，前 60% 拟合、10% 拟合残差分位数），0.05/0.95 分位并扩展区间以覆盖池化边际与均匀连通三元组修正；10%/30% 随机与局部（BFS 生长、必要时重启）掩码，种子 73/101/131；主事件规模 k=3；9 个策略 × 9,696 个共享案例 = 87,264 条轨迹；移动块 bootstrap（3,000 次）配对区间；节点置换（种子 211/307/401）做敏感性检验；Apple M4 上 24 个案例×3 轮计时。

Result: 1) 查询数：30% 掩码下 MOMS 相对筛选随机节省 19.6%–38.5%（如 METR-LA 随机掩码：筛选后 36.00，MOMS 进一步降至 25.76）；两种掩码率下 12 个配对区间全部不含零并偏向 MOMS。但与最短池差异小且依数据集而变，MontevideoBus 四种条件下最短池查询数均低于 MOMS（局部掩码 67.470 vs 67.511），故"优于随机"并不等于稳定优于其他利用见证结构的规则。2) 十次查询内发现：METR-LA 30% 局部掩码下最短见证发现 52 个隐藏正例中的 29 个（MOMS 16、最短池 14、JW 1、筛选随机 3），涉及 34 个不同时刻，但平均解决查询数更高；事后检验显示 52 例中 39 例的真实正三元组完全被隐藏（随机掩码仅 5 例），用前序历史拟合逻辑回归风险分的混合策略使局部掩码查询数从 41.62 升至 52.80、发现数仅从 16 变 17，随机掩码下发现从 47 降至 39。3) 节点序敏感性：三个置换下 METR-LA 局部掩码发现数 MOMS 14–18、最短见证 17–21，最短见证始终领先但差距远小于原始的 16 与 29；MOMS 减最短池的均值差在 WikiMaths 局部掩码下范围 −0.073 至 0.021，重编号可逆转排序；仅改变度数定义不改变原始计数。4) 计算与轨迹一致性：打包 MOMS 复现全部 9,696 条参考轨迹（含 169,041 次查询选择）；分量筛选复现全部 9,696 条筛选随机轨迹（含 239,035 个中间与终止状态）；分量筛选在 METR-LA 局部掩码上快于枚举筛选，但在 MontevideoBus 上更慢；METR-LA 局部掩码计时样本上打包 MOMS 4.94 ms 而分量筛选 0.98 ms，说明减少查询可能带来更高本地计算开销。5) 结论性观察：查询数、事件早期发现与计算量可能分别偏好不同策略；节点重索引会改变部分比较结论；精确停止仅证明所定义事件，不涉及预测区间的统计覆盖。

Conclusion: 本文贡献在于给出一个清晰形式化的审计任务（部分观测下判定连通同侧区间违约事件）、可证明正确的精确停止条件与基于连通分量遍历的等价高效实现，并对既有主动选择原则（MOMS、JW 及其变体）做实证刻画。核心结论有三点：(1) MOMS 显著优于筛选随机基线（19.6%–38.5%），但优势相对其他见证结构启发式规则并不稳健，部分条件下被最短池反超；(2) 更少的查询不必然带来更早的正例发现（最短见证以更高查询成本换来明显更好的十次查询内发现率），也不必然降低本地计算（打包 MOMS 更慢），且发现效率对节点编号顺序敏感；(3) 由此，审计策略的评价必须同时报告查询代价、早期发现与计算开销三个维度，单一准则不足以支撑策略排序。作者明确说明局限：单位查询成本假设、模拟掩码与稀疏正例时间戳、审计期数据反复检视带来的过拟合风险；精确停止依赖于检索无误差，噪声或异步测量需另行建模；结论不构成对含噪系统的策略建议。

Abstract: Graph forecasting systems often rely on prediction intervals to quantify uncertainty across connected locations, but the true outcomes needed for evaluation may be only partially observed. We study how an auditor can selectively retrieve missing outcomes to determine whether there exists a connected group whose outcomes violate the same side of their respective forecast intervals. The audit stops when the observed labels determine the event or the query budget is exhausted. On three public graph time series, MOMS reduces mean queries by 19.6% to 38.5% relative to screened random acquisition when 30% of labels are hidden. Under localized masking on METR-LA, shortest witness finds more positive cases within ten queries, although the difference depends on node ordering. Direct component traversal reproduces all 9,696 screened random traces without enumerating connected subsets. The experiments show that reducing queries to a decision does not necessarily improve early event discovery or reduce local computation.

</details>


### [356] [Accelerating FastDEC Clustering Algorithm with GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03934)
*Mi Li,Eibe Frank,Bernhard Pfahringer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Fast Dominance Estimation Clustering (FastDEC) is an efficient variant of Density Peak Clustering (DPC) that achieves high clustering quality through dominance-based density estimation, but remains constrained by the computational cost of exact k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) construction and dominance component (DC) processing. We present SymWarp-FastDEC, a GPU-accelerated implementation of FastDEC. At its core is SymTrikNN, an exact self-k-NN kernel that exploits search symmetry using upper-triangular traversal and warp-cooperative top-k selection. We also introduce WP-DC, a warp-parallel DC reduction algorithm designed for modern GPUs. Combined with memory-adaptive execution planning and stream scheduling, WP-DC eliminates DC reduction as a runtime bottleneck. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that SymWarp-FastDEC produces clustering outputs identical to the original FastDEC on all evaluated equivalence benchmarks. Compared with a FastDEC variant using FAISS GpuIndexFlatL2 for exact k-NN search, our approach achieves approximately 1.7x to 4.9x higher end-to-end performance, with the advantage generally increasing with dimensionality. Compared with the original single-threaded Python FastDEC implementation, speedups reach approximately 2.5 x 10^4 in a very high-dimensional case where its k-d-tree-based search degrades; this extreme result is not representative of typical acceleration.

We present SymWarp-FastDEC, a GPU-accelerated implementation of FastDEC. ### [357] [Forget What Comes Next: LLM Unlearning via Statistical Independence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03955)
*Andrii Shkabrii,Claudia Plant,Martin Pawelczyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce fragments of their training data, raising privacy and legal concerns that motivate machine unlearning. Yet poisoned training examples can remain statistically detectable after unlearning, which raises the question of whether current unlearning objectives remove what the model has memorized at all. In this work, we introduce PINT, a novel algorithm for machine unlearning that uses the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) to reduce the statistical dependence between tokens to be forgotten and the internal representations used to predict them. We formally relate our HSIC-based objective to Exact Memorization through a computable upper bound, connecting the training objective directly to the model's ability to reproduce the forgotten tokens. In extensive experiments, we compare forgetting-utility trade-offs across eight settings with models up to 7B parameters and demonstrate scalability to 70B parameter models. Our evaluations cover unlearning Gaussian poisons, personal information, hazardous knowledge in biology and cybersecurity, and copyrighted books and news articles. PINT achieves the strongest forgetting-utility trade-off on average and is the only method to make Gaussian poisons undetectable while maintaining near-original model utility. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce fragments of their training data, raising privacy and legal concerns that motivate machine unlearning. Yet poisoned training examples can remain statistically detectable after unlearning, which raises the question of whether current unlearning objectives remove what the model has memorized at all. In this work, we introduce PINT, a novel algorithm for machine unlearning that uses the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) to reduce the statistical dependence between tokens to be forgotten and the internal representations used to predict them. We formally relate our HSIC-based objective to Exact Memorization through a computable upper bound, connecting the training objective directly to the model's ability to reproduce the forgotten tokens. In extensive experiments, we compare forgetting-utility trade-offs across eight settings with models up to 7B parameters and demonstrate scalability to 70B parameter models. Our evaluations cover unlearning Gaussian poisons, personal information, hazardous knowledge in biology and cybersecurity, and copyrighted books and news articles. PINT achieves the strongest forgetting-utility trade-off on average and is the only method to make Gaussian poisons undetectable while maintaining near-original model utility. ### [358] [Sampling Interventional Distributions with Orthogonal MMD Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03962)
*Bariscan Bozkurt,Hugh Dance,Zonghao Chen,Alexandre Galashov,Arthur Gretton,Houssam Zenati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Many causal inference problems require sampling from interventional outcome distributions rather than estimating low-dimensional summaries. Existing approaches often rely on fitting generative models of the target distribution together with additional nuisance components, which can be computationally demanding for high-dimensional outcomes. We propose Interventional Maximum Mean Discrepancy Flow (IMMD-Flow), a particle-based method that instead represents the target interventional distribution through its kernel mean embedding. This kernel embedding admits a doubly robust, Neyman-orthogonal estimator with finite-sample guarantees and can be efficiently reused to sample from the interventional distribution via MMD gradient flow. IMMD-Flow accommodates both hard and soft interventions, admits theoretical guarantees for estimation and particle approximation, and extends to high-dimensional image outcomes through frozen encoders. Across image-based benchmarks, IMMD-Flow matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative approaches while showing significant speed advantages.

### [359] [Ermakov--Based embeddings as a parameter-free layer for physics-informed neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03964)
*Roberto Bernal-Jaquez,Roberto Romero Huerta,Alexander Schaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Evolution equations with time-dependent coefficients force a neural solver to spend capacity on a scale that the equation already determines. We show that a single classical object, the Ermakov-Pinney scale function $\rho$, can be written into the input layer of a physics-informed neural network as a parameter-free embedding. One construction covers three problem families through the two signs of the Pinney constant $c$: linear diffusion ($c=-1$, $\omega\equiv0$), diffusion in a time-dependent confining trap ($c=-1$, $\omega\neq0$), and the quantum oscillator with time-dependent frequency ($c=+1$). An exact moment identity gives $\rho$ in closed form from the initial data alone, so no auxiliary network or knowledge of the solution is needed. Our central finding is comparative: each family requires a different component of the construction and has a different honest control. In family I, the diffusive-time reparametrisation alone reproduces most of the gain, so that family is a poor test of the idea and shows why an ablation is mandatory. In family II no time reparametrisation exists, the control degrades accuracy, and the amplitude prefactor becomes essential (40.8x). In family III the adiabatic approximation also fails, and the quadratic phase factor is what matters (5.7x). The method does not help when the reduced solution does not converge to a fixed point: its extrapolation advantage then disappears. The reduction itself is the classical scaling-variable change of the self-similar-asymptotics literature; what is new is the moment identity that makes it architectural for time-dependent coefficients, and the comparative anatomy above.

### [360] [One Mistake, Three Layers: Persistence Rules Under Depth Correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03968)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Michael Brown,Sanjeda Sara Jennifer,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Probing frozen representations layer by layer is now standard practice, but reporting when a signal first becomes decodable requires a rule for reading a depth curve, and the obvious rule is wrong. On synthetic curves with known ground truth, requiring a probe score to exceed a null-calibrated threshold for three consecutive stages reports an onset nineteen stages early under transformer-like depth correlation, with every resample returning an onset. The failure follows from correlation between neighboring layers, a hazard known in neuroimaging but not, to our knowledge, checked for depth curves. We give an estimator whose error rate is calibrated rather than assumed. Null trajectories are built by permuting labels within each evaluation unit and holding each permutation fixed across depth, preserving the correlation structure the rule must survive; thresholds are per-layer order statistics; and the persistence requirement is calibrated rather than chosen. Applied to pocket information in a frozen co-folding trunk, stratifying 1,820 post-cutoff targets by protein-family and pocket familiarity, the five-stage rule fires on 4 to 7 per cent of null trajectories against a nominal 5 per cent and the three-stage rule on 12 to 17: the synthetic failure reproduces on real data. Pocket membership is decodable above threshold at all 48 blocks in all four regimes, so the onset cannot discriminate them; the pre-declared accumulation depth does, and is latest for familiar families with structurally novel pockets in every feature set. That regime is also the weakest, by a margin surviving controls for length, pocket measure and alignment depth. Separately, a widely used public co-folding checkpoint loads against its own code with 128 trunk parameters missing; those would be randomly initialized, and every representation extracted would be partly noise while appearing normal.

### [361] [Rapid Mean-Field Formation Transport with a Shared-Representation Neural Fokker-Planck Controller](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03981)
*Zejian Zhou,Hao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper develops a mean-field formation transport method with low online computational cost for large-scale multi-agent systems. Classical mean-field planners often require repeated solutions of coupled forward and backward partial differential equations, making online replanning computationally demanding. Density and control are therefore approximated by a common parameterized nonlinear map with separate scalar density and vector control outputs. Parameters are optimized using Fokker--Planck and initial-condition residuals, formation-matching costs on numerically simulated closed-loop particle trajectories, and control effort. Numerical computations are restricted to a bounded region of the state space, with an additional penalty on probability flux across its boundary. For the periodic-domain model, we establish well-posedness of the induced density evolution and bound the density-approximation error in terms of the dynamics and initial-condition residuals. Parameter optimization precedes online operation, during which controller coefficients remain fixed. Experiments quantify the accuracy--runtime trade-off relative to a mean-field planner, show lower transport error than classical feedback baselines, and demonstrate the benefits of the common parameterization.

### [362] [Physics-Informed Identification of Tensegrity Prestress across Taut-Slack Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04007)
*Sandesh Lamsal,Sumit Kumar,Rubi Bhandari,Subhamoy Sen,Andrzej Rutkiewicz,Leszek Małyszko,Landolf Rhode-Barbarigos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prestress governs the stability, stiffness, and dynamic behavior of tensegrity structures, but it is not directly observable from sparse structural measurements, and it may decrease during service life. Under strong excitation, the cables may slacken and the dynamics become nonsmooth. Existing identification methods are limited to the taut regime, and physics-informed networks for tensegrities solve only the forward problem of predicting the response from known member parameters. This study formulates the inverse problem. Neural networks are trained on the equation-of-motion residual in constrained Cartesian coordinates, where the mass matrix is constant and the force densities enter linearly. The force densities, damping, and axial stiffness are trainable parameters, and the tension-only cable law is kept. A Fisher-information analysis shows, before inversion, which member parameters a record can determine. The method is tested on simulated planar tensegrity frames with up to five modules and a three-dimensional prism, and on measured records of a biomimetic leg and a full-scale tensegrity simplex. On the one-module frame, the identifiable force densities are recovered within 1.5% from noisy accelerations at half the free coordinates, on records with and without taut-slack transitions. Records with transitions determine members that taut records leave undetermined. On the five-module frame, a 16-cable two-span bridge, the median force-density error rises moderately, to 4.2%. On measured records, an identified spring stiffness is within 0.1% of its independently measured value on average, and the identified simplex prestress at 13 levels agrees with its cable force transducers to 2.9% root-mean-square.

### [363] [Decision Transformer with Task-Aware Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04010)
*Xinbo Zhao,Yuhang Liu,Xin Zhang,Lei Le,Zhaohan Xi,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: To enable effective generalization in offline meta-RL, it is essential to accurately infer the underlying task through latent task representations, which provide a compact and transferable summary of task-specific characteristics for guiding policy generation. In this paper, we propose Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer (CoTA-DT), a DT-based offline meta-RL framework that learns task representations by jointly integrating four complementary components: (i) contrastive learning from offline trajectories, (ii) alignment with natural-language task descriptions, (iii) one-step supervision via a task-conditioned world model, and (iv) long-term supervision via a task-conditioned Q function. The learned task representations are used as conditioning signals for a DT-based policy, enabling task-aware meta-policy learning. To further support generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings, we design a language-grounded, self-adaptive strategy that enables effective and reliable adaptation to unseen tasks. Notably, in CoTA-DT, the pretrained LLM serves as a shared backbone for language encoding, world modeling, Q-function estimation, and policy learning. This unified design facilitates parameter sharing, improving both efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse offline meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate that CoTA-DT consistently outperforms prior methods, particularly in challenging zero-shot generalization scenarios.

### [364] [Denoising Is Stein: Moment Access and a Resource Hierarchy for Learning Hidden Structure in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04043)
*Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study score learning from denoising pairs when the data contain a hidden non-Gaussian component. If covariance reveals the component, its subspace can be recovered directly. If covariance is isotropic, the first distinguishing moment has order $k^\ast$, and the learner must extract that moment from clean points and their noisy views. Correlations in the denoising loss are Stein discrepancies against a baseline; for polynomial fields they determine exactly the corresponding moment differences. Averaging fresh noisy views conditional on a clean point gives an exact moment query on the clean distribution. In the covariance-matched regime, orientation-independent dictionaries satisfying an $L^4/L^2$ condition need order $d^{k^\ast-1}$ features, and the stated dot-product kernel ridge models need the same power in samples. Small-step online SGD on one unit has this exponent up to logarithms. A two-stage learner uses the curvature of a smoothed denoising loss to recover the hidden direction, then sharpens it and fits a scalar readout. For every even $k^\ast$, it obtains a fixed score gain over the Gaussian baseline from $O(d^{k^\ast/2}\log d)$ clean points. In the covariance-visible regime, the frozen-feature threshold occurs at $d^J/J!$, while projection onto principal components makes the fitted-model, score-risk and generated-law distributions independent of ambient dimension. In the covariance-matched experiments, the measured partial-trace overlaps are consistent with the proposed spectral transition. A width-8 network trained with clean-point reuse shows a $d^2$-like training-set threshold over $d=64$--$192$, with fixed validation and calibration overhead.

### [365] [Structured Priors: Towards an algebra of component priors for prior-data fitted networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04056)
*Thomas Bartz-Beielstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prior-data fitted networks are typically trained using synthetic data generated by a single, manually constructed generator. In cases where such a generator combines multiple components, e.g., in TabPFN, Mitra, or TabICLv2, this is achieved through a mixture using manually specified weights, the impact of which on the network only becomes apparent after pre-training. Instead of such a hand-built generator, this work proposes a structured prior: a small set of named component priors, linked by operators whose algebraic properties are formally proven and whose influence on the trained network has been validated. Within a measure-theoretic framework, the operators of mixture, convolution, amplitude scaling, local transform, and projection are defined. Their governing laws are proven. These operators are implemented in the macl2l software package. Experiments demonstrate that the implemented generators reproduce the identities within the resolution of a permutation test. Furthermore, it is shown that trained networks obey the distributive law; that a mixed prior composed of small components performs as well as or better than any individual component in seven out of eight open regression benchmarks; and that on two of these tables a structured prior reaches, with a ninth of the data budget, an error that a generic random-function prior does not reach even with the full budget. A theorem on model averaging demonstrates that networks trained on individual components constitute the Bayes predictor for the mixture, provided that the component networks are themselves the Bayes predictors for their respective priors. However, the pre-registered test of this averaged predictor with trained component networks failed, because the networks identify the generating component too rarely. The paper proposes a research program focused on the algebra of structured priors for prior-data fitted networks.

### [366] [StreamLTT: Risk Certification for Policy Selection under Stream Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04062)
*Jinwen Xu,Qin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Learn-then-Test (LTT) provides a general framework for certifying deployment policies against a prescribed risk target, but its standard formulation targets a fixed population risk estimated from calibration losses. In sequential deployment, losses may instead be dependent and nonstationary, so the risk of a fixed policy can evolve with the observed history. We introduce StreamLTT, which replaces this fixed population risk with average predictable risk, defined by conditioning each decision's loss on the information available before its outcome is revealed. Conditional centering turns empirical deviations from this target into a martingale sum, enabling both a test that adapts to predictable variance and a finite-sample Hoeffding alternative. Combined with family-wise error rate control, StreamLTT yields a simultaneously certified policy region that supports subsequent deployment selection. Across seven forecasting datasets and seven deployment risks, StreamLTT places the certified frontier substantially closer to the prescribed risk target than IID, robust-variance, block-bootstrap, and concentration-based alternatives, while empirical family-wise error closely follows the prescribed level. A finite-sample ablation further shows that the predictable-risk formulation drives the tighter risk frontier, while adaptation to predictable variance makes more effective use of the available family-wise error budget. StreamLTT therefore extends risk-certified policy selection to dependent deployment streams by addressing both what risk should be certified and how it should be tested.

### [367] [TB-Transolver: Parallelized and Coherent Long-Horizon Rollouts via Temporal Bundling for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04063)
*Sidharth S. Menon,Ameya D. Jagtap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Transolver has recently gained widespread adoption for solving diverse physical problems on unstructured geometric meshes by leveraging its Physics-Attention mechanism, which seamlessly extends standard softmax attention to handle physical domains at scale. For time-dependent problems, existing literature relies on time-conditioned or autoregressive rollouts to preserve temporal causality while retaining Physics-Attention as the spatial backbone. However, a fundamental limitation of this formulation is its sequential execution model, wherein computational costs scale linearly with the temporal horizon, rendering standard Transolver inefficient for transient problems despite its exceptional spatial efficacy. This bottleneck has historically hindered its broader application in time-dependent physical modeling. To address this limitation, we introduce TB-Transolver (also referred to as Temporally Bundled Transolver), an efficient framework built on temporal bundling that scales Transolver for time-dependent PDEs. Furthermore, we propose \emph{spatiotemporal coherence} (${\rm C(K)}$) as a general metric to systematically quantify snapshot correlation within a temporal bundle, enabling the \emph{a priori} selection of optimal bundle widths using training data alone, thereby avoiding expensive grid searches. We demonstrate the computational efficacy of TB-Transolver across four physically distinct domains, namely, plasticity, fluid dynamics, reaction-diffusion, and global weather forecasting; achieving training speedups of up to $29\times$ over conventional autoregressive and time-conditioned baselines. Finally, these computational gains are further amplified through distributed multi-node and multi-GPU parallelism, yielding aggregated speedups of up to $45.6\times$ at optimal bundle widths for systems exhibiting high spatiotemporal coherence compared to single-GPU implementations.

Abstract: Transolver has recently gained widespread adoption for solving diverse physical problems on unstructured geometric meshes by leveraging its Physics-Attention mechanism, which seamlessly extends standard softmax attention to handle physical domains at scale. For time-dependent problems, existing literature relies on time-conditioned or autoregressive rollouts to preserve temporal causality while retaining Physics-Attention as the spatial backbone. However, a fundamental limitation of this formulation is its sequential execution model, wherein computational costs scale linearly with the temporal horizon, rendering standard Transolver inefficient for transient problems despite its exceptional spatial efficacy. This bottleneck has historically hindered its broader application in time-dependent physical modeling. To address this limitation, we introduce TB-Transolver (also referred to as Temporally Bundled Transolver), an efficient framework built on temporal bundling that scales Transolver for time-dependent PDEs. Furthermore, we propose \emph{spatiotemporal coherence} (${\rm C(K)}$) as a general metric to systematically quantify snapshot correlation within a temporal bundle, enabling the \emph{a priori} selection of optimal bundle widths using training data alone, thereby avoiding expensive grid searches. We demonstrate the computational efficacy of TB-Transolver across four physically distinct domains, namely, plasticity, fluid dynamics, reaction-diffusion, and global weather forecasting; achieving training speedups of up to $29\times$ over conventional autoregressive and time-conditioned baselines. Finally, these computational gains are further amplified through distributed multi-node and multi-GPU parallelism, yielding aggregated speedups of up to $45.6\times$ at optimal bundle widths for systems exhibiting high spatiotemporal coherence compared to single-GPU implementations.

</details>


### [368] [Graph-Localized Coverage for Conformal Prediction on Inductive Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04066)
*Jinwen Xu,Qin Lu,Georgios B. Giannakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Conformal prediction (CP) provides marginal coverage guarantees, but marginal coverage does not determine where prediction errors occur on a graph. Queries from different graph neighborhoods can exhibit substantially different levels of uncertainty even when aggregate coverage remains near its target. We introduce GLocalCP, an online CP framework for inductive node classification and edge prediction that combines marginal and graph-local calibration with uncertainty-adaptive prediction sets. Specifically, GLocalCP puts forth a novel uncertainty-adaptive nonconformality score that relies on the mutual information obtained from Monte-Carlo (MC) dropout based prediction. Then, it augments a global online threshold with a kernel-based local correction that propagates coverage feedback among similar graph queries. On the theoretical horizon, we establish pathwise $O(N^{-1/2})$ marginal calibration error without exchangeability or stationarity and, for the exact-kernel formulation, an explicit $O(N^{-1/2})$ graph-localized calibration guarantee. Experiments on seven node-classification and seven edge-prediction benchmarks show that similar marginal coverage can conceal substantially different local reliability. Our proposed GLocalCP maintains coverage near the target while consistently reducing graph-local calibration error. Uncertainty scaling in GLocalCP further reduces prediction-set size across all evaluated node and edge datasets while leaving marginal coverage essentially unchanged.

### [369] [Finite-Sample Convergence in Networked Average Reward MARL: Decentralization Pitfalls and Entropy Remedies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04072)
*Yizhou Zhang,Yashaswini Murthy,Laixi Shi,Adam Vierman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study the problem of average reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) where agents interact within a network. Each agent in the network conducts local updates with information within its $k$-hop neighborhood and collaboratively maximizes the overall reward of the entire network. We first provide impossibility results in achieving convergence to the global optimal joint policies in our setting. These impossibility results highlight the challenges of decentralized learning with local information in multi-agent systems, namely the issues of multiagency, where each agent independently optimizes its policy, and partial observability, where agents have limited visibility into the global state. Given these challenges which indicate that decentralized policy optimization can generally be certified only up to stationarity, we provide finite-sample convergence guarantees for a decentralized actor-critic algorithm with linear function approximation that converges to an approximate stationary point with small gradient norm. To overcome such impossibility results, we further show that adding fixed-state entropy regularization reshapes the objective landscape which leads to even stronger global convergence guarantees for our proposed actor-critic algorithm.

### [370] [Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04073)
*Anh Nguyen,Tianyi Xu,Phat Tran,Harry Yu,Huazheng Wang,Stefan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component -- tutorials, the judge, and the world model -- to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: two datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. To isolate the effect of world models given tutorials, we compare RAG-PJ with and without common world models: using either zero-shot text-based descriptions of next states or an oracle that returns ground-truth visual observations. We find that RAG-PJ gains little benefit from these rollouts when tutorials are present, even with perfect visual futures. This suggests prior world-model gains in tutorial-conditioned methods come mainly from tutorial understanding and the judge's ability to select the proposed actions, rather than from predicted rollouts. Error analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not rollout fidelity, but the judge's ability to reason over future states and recognize task completion. This highlights the need to improve not just next-state prediction in world models, but also reasoning over their predicted rollouts. Datasets and code are available at this https URL .

### [371] [RAPID: Increasing Efficiency of Internal Distillation via Randomized Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04081)
*Ryan Swift,Konstantinos Psounis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Knowledge distillation is a technique used to transfer the expertise of large teacher models into small, efficient student models. Recent advances have integrated the distillation of internal activations, more directly training students to learn similar representations as the teacher. One of the core challenges of internal distillation is the dimensional incompatibility between the student and teacher internal representations. Existing methods add learnable matrices to project the larger teacher activations into the smaller representation space of the student. This is a notable point of inefficiency, as learning additional parameters for the projectors increases training costs, only for them to be discarded immediately after training. We introduce RAPID (RAndomized Projection for Internal Distillation) a novel distillation methodology which eliminates the wasteful projection learning by leveraging randomized methods. RAPID utilizes an efficient transform construction based on the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma to compress the teacher representations into the student embedding space with strong theoretical guarantees of structural preservation. RAPID also employs a combination of exponential moving average (EMA) and homoscedastic uncertainty weighting in a novel multi-objective function designed for internal distillation. Our experiments in post-training for reasoning demonstrate that RAPID increases training efficiency by as much as 21.1% while maintaining performance comparable to existing methods.

### [372] [Follow the Features: SAE Feature-Guided Data-Efficient Instruction-Tuning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04085)
*Ryan Swift,Konstantinos Psounis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Selecting small, effective instruction-tuning datasets requires identifying which aspects of the original data to retain. We introduce Follow the Features (FtF), a data-selection method that uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to characterize training data and guide subset construction. FtF ranks features using dataset-level activation statistics, scores samples by their expression of highly ranked features, and incorporates feature resampling to encourage diversity. The LLM-SAE pair used for selection is independent of the model being fine-tuned, enabling reuse across target models. We evaluate FtF on two model-dataset settings at a training budget of 100 samples with a fixed sequence length of 256 tokens. FtF achieves performance competitive with GRAPE and S2L, with relative rankings varying across settings. On Qwen 3 8B trained on Alpaca, FtF exceeds full-dataset training by 1.59 percentage points in the harmonic mean of an AlpacaEval-based win rate and Open LLM Leaderboard performance, although full-dataset training retains a higher Leaderboard score. These results support SAE feature statistics as a useful signal for data-efficient instruction tuning.

### [373] [ScaleTraj: Scale-Decomposed Human Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04097)
*Yulin Zeng,Yiheng Zhao,Jun Yan,Yuhong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Individual-level trajectories are essential for applications that rely on user-level mobility behavior. Existing mobility-generation approaches face a fundamental tension between individual-level and population-level statistical fidelity: top-down models reproduce aggregate mobility statistics but struggle to guarantee realistic individual trajectories, while bottom-up generators synthesize individual trajectories yet often fail to preserve key population-level mobility regularities after aggregation. In particular, many bottom-up generated populations fail to reproduce the displacement distribution, whose heavy tail is well summarized by a truncated power law. We formalize this phenomenon as the \textbf{Population-Level Displacement Gap}. To investigate its prevalence, we conduct a systematic evaluation of representative model-driven and data-driven trajectory generators. Our results provide evidence that the Population-Level Displacement Gap is prevalent across diverse generation paradigms. To diagnose this gap, we introduce the \textbf{Scale Fidelity Profile (SFP)}, a scale-decomposed metric that quantifies discrepancies in trip allocations across spatial scales. SFP indicates that population-level displacement mismatches co-occur with systematic errors in how trips are allocated across spatial scales. Motivated by this observation, we develop \textbf{ScaleTraj}, an autoregressive Transformer that decomposes location prediction into a Scale Selection Head that decides the movement scale and a Scale-Aware Cell Selection Head that predicts the destination conditioned on the selected scale. Experiments on two datasets show that ScaleTraj reduces the Population-Level Displacement Gap versus model-driven and data-driven baselines, while preserving fidelity. Our code is available at this https URL .

### [374] [When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04098)
*Teng-Ruei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and resampling Nano three times gives practically the same empirical any-correct rate as calling all three models once. Only 31 responses reached the cap, 25 of them with exactly periodic tails, yet the capped responses account for up to 60.2% of a model's output-length-squared proxy, and long generations made a fourth planned model, Llama-3.1-8B, too slow to finish. The premium is far below the companion's 3.5 pp, but models, pool size and protocol changed together; an oracle gap should therefore be reported with the pool, the protocol, the samples per cell and the decoding budget that produced it.

### [375] [ModelBlaster: Closing the Performance Gap through Learning-Augmented Agents Across Models, Kernels and Hardware Backends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04104)
*Shengjun Kris Dong,Dima Nikiforov,Sahil Modi,Sana Damani,Edward C Lin,Siva Kumar Sastry Hari,Christos Kozyrakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Optimizing accelerator code across hardware architectures is difficult. ML compilers search predefined spaces of schedules and micro-kernels, while LLM-guided optimization can explore alternative algorithms, operator decompositions, and hardware-specific techniques. However, existing LLM agents typically target a single programming interface, toolchain, or accelerator family, focus on kernel-level optimization without model-level transforms, and offer limited reuse of experience across hardware targets. We present ModelBlaster, a Memory-Augmented In-Context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework for optimizing data-parallel kernels and whole models across heterogeneous SIMD and SIMT accelerators. Its mutable policy is a persistent knowledge base updated at inference time by Actor-Critic Textual Gradient Descent (AC-TGD). The knowledge base maps performance states to actions, outcomes, and constraints, enabling experience reuse across kernels, models, and hardware targets. A model-level optimizer uses kernel-level knowledge to inform whole-model decisions. The same optimization loop and knowledge schema support CUDA on NVIDIA GPUs, OpenCL on Qualcomm GPUs, and RVV intrinsics on RISC-V vector cores, with only lowering and measurement layers specific to each target. Compared with PyTorch, ModelBlaster achieves geometric-mean speedups of 1.85x, 5.58x, and 5.18x on KernelBench Levels 1, 2, and 3, and 1.69x on SOL-ExecBench Levels 1 and 2 on a B200 GPU. On Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, it achieves 5.8x over the vendor SDK and 1.7x over Apache TVM; on RISC-V vector cores, it achieves 2.7x over ExecuTorch with XNNPACK across 70 KernelBench problems.

### [376] [Structure, Dimensionality, and Distribution Shape - What Makes Pretraining Data Transferable, and Why the Input Pipeline Decides Which](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04106)
*Sangyoon Bae,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: What makes a pretraining corpus transferable? We describe a corpus by three properties: its structure, its dimensionality, and the distribution shape of each unit's values. We propose the Transfer-Invariance Principle: the same property can be irrelevant to transfer under one input transform and decisive under another, so the model's input transform, not the data modality, decides which properties can matter. To test it we build TransferForge, a generator that places a synthetic population at any prescribed structure, dimensionality, and distribution shape. KernelSynth, the synthetic prior of Chronos, cannot, because it draws independent series. When the model standardizes each input window (PatchTST on UCR), the distribution shape is inert and the structural setting governs. Synthetic pretraining then matches a real corpus of the same size and exceeds it once scaled. When the model encodes calcium fluorescence signals without normalization (POYO Plus), the shape becomes a governing constraint, and a shape-matched synthetic corpus replaces real pretraining with zero real neural activity. Flipping only the input normalization, with the model and data fixed, changes the effect of a shape manipulation by a factor of 5.3, so the pipeline, not the modality, sets the switch. The principle yields a recipe that chooses what to synthesize before any training. Pretraining data then becomes something to manufacture for the model, most valuably where real data is scarce, expensive, or private.

### [377] [Decomposing Rank Reversals under Temporal Nonstationarity: Alignment, Aggressiveness, and Instability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04116)
*Deying Song,Xueying Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Under temporal nonstationarity, model performance rankings reverse across training horizons due to heterogeneous sensitivities to memory. While existing literature addresses adaptive lookbacks, effective model complexity, and empirical forecast evaluation in isolation, no unified framework explains the structural mechanics driving these rank reversals. We bridge this gap by deriving a model-agnostic decomposition of out-of-sample $R^2$ into target alignment, miscalibrated aggressiveness, and predictive instability. Within this framework, we mathematically characterize complexity phase boundaries, establish closed-form optimal-memory equations for ridge regression under local drift, and extend these guarantees to complex model architectures via surrogate bounds. We validate these theoretical dynamics by benchmarking 14 linear, tree-based, and neural architectures across large-scale financial panels. In doing so, our framework demonstrates that empirical model rank reversals are driven by predictable surges in miscalibrated aggressiveness, providing a rigorous mechanistic diagnosis of generalization under temporal shift.
